Who We Are:

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can’t solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we’re looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview:

We are looking for a hands-on electrician or automation technician to support the build, installation, and optimization of our robotic systems. You will be responsible for wiring, testing, and commissioning electrical components both in our lab and on-site. You will collaborate closely with mechanical and software teams to ensure seamless system integration, resolve technical issues, and implement improvements across new and existing systems.

Your Responsibilities:

Installation & Integration

  • Build and wire electrical systems for robotic applications, including cabinets and field wiring. 

  • Support system commissioning in the robotics lab and at customer locations.  

  • Work closely with mechanical and software engineers to ensure correct system integration.  

  • Implement technical improvements and modifications based on project feedback.  

  • Diagnose and resolve electrical faults during development and deployment.

Qualifications:

Education and Experience

  • Completed technical training (e.g. State-certified Technician in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or Automation) or a comparable vocational qualification (e.g. Electrician, Control Cabinet Builder, Electrical Master)

  • Certified to perform electrical work (Elektrofachkraft – EFK)

  • Relevant professional experience in automation or robotics preferred

  • Willingness to travel: ≈ 25-50%

Skills

  • Experience with electrical installations, control systems, sensors, and actuators  

  • Hands-on mentality and technical craftsmanship

  • Basic knowledge of EPLAN/Splan is a plus

  • Valid Class B driver’s license (EU)

Our interview plan:

  • Application

  • Take‑home assignment: You’ll work on a short, role‑relevant task with clear instructions and a deadline.

  • Cultural fit interview (40 min): A conversation about how you work, what motivates you, and what you’re looking for. Expect CV highlights, your “why,” and time for your questions.

  • Technical fit interview (45 min): A deeper dive into your skills and problem‑solving approach for this role.

  • On‑site visit: Meet the team in our office and collaborate on a real challenge similar to the work you’d do here. You’ll also meet a founder; we aim to give you a clear feel for the role and environment.

What We Offer:

  • Wellpass (gym membership)  

  • Flexible working hours  

  • Option to work from home when needed  

  • A motivated team and an open corporate culture  

  • Competitive compensation and excellent career development opportunities

At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader. We’re backed by top VCs, including Octopus Ventures, Neosfer (Commerzbank), founders of Signavio and many more business angels.

About The Role:

We’re hiring a BDR SMB to further expand our SMB segment in the UKI & Benelux region.

You will join our Go-To-Market team and work alongside other team members focused on SMB accounts. Together, you will drive and scale our SMB motion through consistent, high-volume outbound execution.

Your main mission: build pipeline and generate high-quality opportunities for Sales. You will work closely with GTM Leadership and Account Executives to ensure a steady flow of well-qualified meetings.

This is a high-energy, execution-focused role. It is ideal for someone early in their sales career who wants to grow fast, take ownership early, and prove themselves in a performance-driven environment.

What You'll Do:

You will play a key role in building predictable SMB pipeline.

We don’t micromanage — we give context, trust, and ownership. You’ll have the freedom to test, iterate, and improve how we approach SMB expansion, while being fully accountable for your results.

You will:

  • Own your dedicated SMB territory in the UKI & Benelux region

  • Build net-new pipeline through high-volume outbound execution

  • Execute structured multi-channel outreach: cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn

  • Consistently maintain high activity levels and daily outreach targets

  • Run discovery and qualification calls with SMB prospects

  • Hand over well-qualified opportunities to Account Executives

  • Maintain clean CRM hygiene and pipeline tracking in HubSpot

  • Identify small automation improvements to increase efficiency

  • Use feedback and data to continuously improve outreach performance

This is a numbers-driven hunter role. Success is measured by pipeline generated, meetings booked, activity levels, and targets achieved.

About You:

You are ambitious, resilient, and highly execution-driven. You are not afraid to pick up the phone — repeatedly.

You bring:

  • 1+ years of experience (internship, working student, or full-time) in a fast-paced environment (startup, consulting, sales, business development, etc.)

  • A completed commercial training (equivalent to e.g. “kaufmännische Ausbildung”) or a Bachelor’s degree

  • A strong ownership mindset — you take responsibility for hitting targets

  • Excellent English skills (CEFR C2 level)

  • Confidence in cold calling and proactive outbound outreach

  • High energy, persistence, and comfort with rejection

  • A structured and disciplined working style

  • A data-driven mindset and comfort working with KPIs

You see this role as the foundation for building a long-term career in Sales.

Nice-to-have:

  • First experience in Business Development or Sales

  • Exposure to B2B SaaS

  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Experience in an early-stage startup (Series A–B)

  • First knowledge of the target market UKI / Benelux

What We Offer:

  • Remote Work: 100% remote work with a virtual office in Gather.

  • Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.

  • Equity: Generous equity package – we’re all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success.

  • Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors.

  • Development Budget: €1,000 annual personal development budget.

  • Home office Budget: Home office budget and access to co-working spaces.

  • Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays.

  • Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (last year we’re headed to Costa Brava!).

  • Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun!

  • Tech Equipment: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, headphones).

Interview Process:

  • Intro call with Talent team

  • Cold call with hiring manager

  • Take-home assignment

  • 60–90 min – Assignment review & interview with GTM Lead

  • 45 min – Final interview with Co-Founders

Please note: We are an equal-opportunity employer and remote-only company. At this time, we can support hiring only within EU time zones. We work in sync using Gather as our virtual office. As a small fast-growing company, we believe in the need for an in-sync component of daily communication and therefore cannot support 100% asynchronous work. Read more about our Remote Culture here.

This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Salary Range: €55K - €68K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

We're looking for a Marketing Communications Manager (B2B) who spans brand and growth marketing - someone versatile enough to move across content and product marketing, but with a clear centre of gravity in storytelling and strategic content production. You'll be part of a hybrid team where everyone covers more than one surface, and you'll have real ownership across multiple workstreams from day one to do whatever brings the most impact to reach our company goals.

The core of the job is making Almedia’s expertise and brand impossible to ignore in the space of gaming, advertising, technology, data, consumer apps, scale-ups and growth companies, so we get noticed by partners. That means finding the signal inside a technically complex business, turning it into content that actually moves people and deals, and then making sure it reaches the right personas in the right way. The measure of success is simple: how many more people know about Almedia, and how many stakeholders reach out to us because of our initiatives and the collateral we publish, rather than the other way around.

You'll report to our Global B2B Marketing Lead, work closely with PR and event managers, and collaborate with the growth team and C-Suite to continuously develop the Almedia brand.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Drive flagship brand campaigns. Own brand campaigns end to end - from identifying the high-impact opportunity and building the story, through to channel rollout and measurement. You decide what gets done, made and why. The standard is that it needs to be worth actioning, not just worth reading.

  • Leverage the team. Find ways to use our 150+ people to source content and amplify the message, without adding to their workload, but making their contributions count.

  • Build and distribute the growth content engine. Develop white papers sourced from our own data, case studies with real customer evidence, a monthly newsletter, and campaign assets for our flagship events, then own how they get out into the world. Identify the right channels, the right timing, and the right formats to make sure what gets made actually gets read. Track whether it's working and adjust.

  • Make sales self-sufficient. Build a product marketing toolkit for Freecash and Link, including messaging, one-pagers, pitch decks, and case studies, so that active deals and existing partnerships use the collateral instead of improvised slides. Track adoption and close the loop with the sales team on what's actually working.

  • Grow Almedia's presence. Turn the work you produce into reputation. The white papers, case studies, and campaign assets you create should be doing double duty, showing up in pitches, feeding into event narratives, and giving Almedia a clear point of view in a crowded market. The goal is that people in our industry know who we are and what we stand for, because the content speaks for itself.

  • Bring stakeholders along. Get internal buy-in for marketing initiatives from people who have other priorities. Whether it's sourcing a customer story from sales, getting a C-Suite perspective into a white paper, or aligning leadership on a campaign direction, you know how to make marketing a team effort without making it someone else's problem.

  • Support event planning and execution. Organise the conferences, sponsorships, and brand activations Almedia shows up to — logistics, booth setup, timelines, vendor coordination.

What Your First 90 Days Look Like

  • Month 1: Learn the product suite, the sales motion, and the content gaps. Audit existing collateral and identify what's missing or not being used. Get onboarded on the brand activities and support planned activations and events with narrative and copy.

  • Month 2: Ship your first white paper or flagship content asset and own its distribution. Conceptualise a brand or growth-focused event.

  • Month 3: Own the growth side of the social and website content calendar. Have a working content calendar in place, and a feedback loop running between you, sales, and leadership on what's resonating. By this point you're running on your own.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Strategic content thinking. You approach content as a lever, not a deliverable. You ask what outcome a piece needs to drive before you write a word, and you're just as focused on distribution and measurement as you are on the writing itself. You're not here to fill a content calendar, you're here to shift how our market thinks about Almedia.

  • C2-level B2B writing. You can take a complex product or technical concept and produce something a busy CMO would read in full. Long-form assets, white papers, case studies, product one-pagers, come out publish-ready, not draft-ready. You self-edit hard and don't need someone to rewrite your work.

  • Story sourcing instinct. You know how to find the interesting thing inside a business: the data point that reframes a conversation, the customer story that proves the value prop, the internal perspective that hasn't been said publicly yet. You don't wait for a brief to hand you a story.

  • Product marketing fundamentals. You've built or maintained messaging frameworks, value propositions, and sales collateral before. You understand how B2B buyers think and what makes a case study actually useful in a sales conversation versus something that sits in a Notion folder.

  • Project ownership. Complex projects, a website section, a flagship report, a product launch toolkit, run on your calendar, not someone else's. You track dependencies, manage vendors or freelancers when needed, and communicate proactively when something is off track.

  • Bonus: German or Turkish language skills for PR coordination.

  • Bonus: Background in adtech, mobile gaming, or performance marketing.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Own Everything: A piece of content doesn't leave your hands until it's genuinely good, and neither does its distribution or results. You take accountability for the full outcome, not just your section of it.

  • Take Initiative: You spot the gap or content opportunity before someone points it out and you've already started filling it.

  • Move Fast: You run multiple workstreams in parallel, make decisions with incomplete information, and ship rather than polish indefinitely.

  • Focus on Impact: You know which content will move the needle and which is just noise, and you spend your time on the former. If something isn't working, you change course.

  • Raise the Bar: You push back when a brief is vague, when a case study is too generic, or when a deck doesn't actually say anything. High standards aren't a personality trait here, they're the job.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

At Yepoda, Korean effectiveness meets sustainable solutions: our mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea. Our mission is to bring the best beauty innovations from Korea straight to Europe – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. All our products are made with the best natural and active ingredients, are vegan and cruelty-free. We aim to make the K-Beauty routine easy, effective, and fun.

We are a beauty start-up founded in 2020 and located in the heart of Berlin. Our team is composed of over 130 brilliant human beings who came from all over the world to write Yepoda’s story actively.

We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our team at Yepoda. This role will involve overseeing financial operations, ensuring compliance with German accounting standards, and supporting the team as we continue to scale.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee day-to-day financial operations including bookkeeping, invoicing, and payment processing

  • Assist and take ownership with monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements preparation

  • Support during the statutory audits and ensure compliance with tax and legal regulations

  • Support on implementing ERP system and setting up new projects and flows from scratch on

  • Prepare cash flow statements and monitor cash on hand

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to support other departments with financial insights


Requirements:

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field

  • 6+ years of relevant work experience in finance and accounting

  • Fluent in English, German/Italian/French/Spanish are a plus

  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and hands-on mentality

  • Process driven and excited about setting up new projects and flows from scratch on

  • Experience in e-commerce and cross-border VAT is a plus

  • Knowledge of German GAAP (HGB) and experience with Oracle Netsuite are a plus

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day one, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: Work 3 days in the office and enjoy the flexibility of remote working the rest of the week.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: Enjoy Yepoda products at a discount and share them with friends and family.

Ready to be a part of our journey? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. You will own a selected set of the models, stretching over domains, e.g. microwave physics to plasma radiation.These models will be used by the design team to compute load cases, assess system-level tradeoffs, perform numerical optimization, and simulate the whole machine as a single system. data.title: Pizzabäcker / Pizzaiolo (m/w/d) Südwest

data.description:
Deine Mission

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde.
Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen.

Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch.

Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender.

Konkret:

  • ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt.
  • DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden.
  • ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste Rückmeldung, die wir zum Produkt bekommen. Du bist die direkteste Leitung dorthin und nutzt sie.
  • BEZIEHUNG STATT KONTAKTLISTE: Du übernimmst einen festen Kreis von Partnern. Nach drei Monaten kennen die deinen Namen, nicht unsere Rufnummer.
  • SAUBER NACHHALTEN: Was besprochen wurde, landet nachvollziehbar in Hubspot, damit das Team damit weiterarbeiten kann.


Dein Talent

  • SUSTAINABILITY: Du interessierst dich sehr für Klimaschutz und Nachhaltigkeit und willst mehr darüber lernen und bewegen

  • WORKING STUDENT: Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium und bringst idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen mit, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder ehrenamtliches Engagement

  • AM TELEFON ZU HAUSE: Du hast schon mal jemanden am Telefon von etwas überzeugt — im Job, im Verein, im Nebenjob, egal.

  • AUF DEN PUNKT, OHNE KALT ZU WIRKEN: Du sagst in drei Sätzen, wofür andere zehn brauchen, und klingst dabei trotzdem wie ein Mensch. Handwerksbetriebe haben keine Zeit für Marketing-Sprache und merken sofort, wenn jemand welche spricht.

  • ZUVERLÄSSIG, NICHT VERHANDELBAR: Zugesagter Rückruf am Donnerstag heißt Donnerstag. Das ist bei uns Grundvoraussetzung, keine Stärke.

  • DU BRINGST WAS ZURÜCK: Nach fünfzig Gesprächen hast du eine Meinung dazu, was funktioniert. Du sagst sie, ohne dass wir danach fragen müssen.

  • DEUTSCH AUF MUTTERSPRACHNIVEAU: Unsere Partner sind deutsche Handwerksbetriebe. Das Gespräch läuft auf Deutsch, inklusive Zwischentöne und Dialekt am anderen Ende.

  • MINDESTENS 6 MONATE ZEIT: Kürzer lohnt sich für keinen von uns beiden. Bis du richtig gut in diesen Gesprächen bist, vergehen Wochen.


Unser Angebot

Wachstum & Kultur

Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur fachlich durchstartet, sondern aktiv eine gesunde und nachhaltige Unternehmenskultur lebt. Bei uns zählt das Miteinander genauso viel wie der Erfolg.

Impact & Awareness

Deine Stimme hat Gewicht, im Büro und darüber hinaus. Neben deinem regulären Urlaub bekommst du zusätzliche freie Tage für Klimaaktivismus, Demos oder Projekte, die dir am Herzen liegen.

Flexibilität & Vertrauen

Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinem Rhythmus. Nutze unsere Flexdays, um mobil zu arbeiten – egal ob von zu Hause oder unterwegs innerhalb Deutschlands, immer in Absprache mit deinem Team.

Extra Benefits für dich

Wir machen deinen Alltag einfacher: Du bekommst einen flexiblen Bonus, den du nach Lust und Laune für Dinge einsetzen kannst, die dir Freude machen – ob Fitness, Kultur oder kleine Extras.

Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden

Wenn der Arbeitstag mal länger wird, sorgen wir dafür, dass niemand hungrig bleibt. Bestell dir über Wolt eine Mahlzeit direkt ins Büro – easy und lecker.

Community & Spirit

Wir verändern die Welt – und verlieren dabei nie den Spaß. Freu dich auf regelmäßige Offsites, Teamabende und unser legendäres „Bees & Beers“ als perfekten Ausgleich zu unserer Mission.

data.title: Werkstudent Go-To-Market & Partner Management (m/w/d)

data.description:
Was du bei uns machen wirst:

Wie bringt man Menschen dazu, sich freiwillig mit ihrer Steuererklärung zu beschäftigen?

Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Als Performance Creative Strategist bei Zasta entwickelst du Ideen, Hooks und Kampagnen, die aus einem komplexen Finanzthema relevante und unterhaltsame Werbung machen – und gleichzeitig messbar performen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Paid Social, insbesondere Meta und TikTok. Gleichzeitig hast du die Möglichkeit, erfolgreiche Social-First-Ansätze auf TV zu übertragen und den Kanal gemeinsam mit uns neu zu denken.

Dabei bekommst du viel konzeptionellen Freiraum: Du entwickelst neue Creative Angles, hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze und findest über Daten, Zielgruppen-Insights und Testing heraus, welche Botschaften wirklich funktionieren.

  • Zielgruppen wirklich verstehen: Du analysierst Zielgruppen, ihre Bedürfnisse und ihre Mediennutzung. Du weißt, wie sich Botschaften je nach Kanal und Funnel-Stufe unterscheiden müssen – und setzt genau dort an.
  • Brücke zwischen Data & Kreativität sein: Du arbeitest eng mit Performance-Marketing, Data & Kreativ-Agenturen zur Ableitung und Optimierung von Creatives anhand von KPIs zusammen und übersetzt das in neue kreative Ansätze.
  • TV neu denken: Du hast Lust, TV nicht als verstaubten Kanal zu sehen, sondern als Spielfeld für starke, moderne Markenkommunikation, die klare Performance bringt. Du bringst frische Ideen ein und denkst TV konsequent aus der Social-Logik heraus.
  • Testing & Learnings vorantreiben: Du denkst in Iterationen, entwickelst Testing-Frameworks für Creatives und sorgst dafür, dass Learnings systematisch zurück in neue Konzepte fließen.


Was du idealerweise mitbringst:

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy, Creative Conception, Art Direction oder Kampagnenentwicklung. Idealerweise warst du vorher in einem digitalen Performance-Umfeld tätig. 
  • Du bringst ein tiefes Verständnis für den Bereich Paid Social (z.B. Meta, TikTok) mit und hast Interesse oder erste Erfahrungen im TV-Umfeld.
  • Du zeigst ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für leadorientierte Performance-Kampagnen und ein Gespür für Zielgruppenpsychologie- du kannst Insights, Daten und Business-Ziele in klare kreative Strategien übersetzen.
  • Du bist neugierig, probierst Dinge aus und hast Lust, Konventionen zu hinterfragen. Du denkst nicht nur in Slides, sondern auch in konkreten Umsetzungen und setzt Ideen proaktiv um.
  • Für die interne und externe Kommunikation sprichst du Deutsch auf C1-Level und bist sicher in der Nutzung gängiger englischer Marketing- und Strategy-Begriffe.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau 


Was wir dir bieten:

  • Wir sind ein profitables Unternehmen, das nachhaltig wächst. Unser Management kennt jeden, der bei uns arbeitet. 
  • Mit Büros in Rostock und Berlin kannst du frische Seeluft schnuppern oder dich vom Großstadtdschungel mitreißen lassen. Regelmäßige Besuche und Team-Events sorgen für das Gemeinschaftsgefühl.
  • Je nach Standort treffen wir uns an zwei Tagen die Woche vor Ort im Büro - dienstags und mittwochs in Rostock und mittwochs und donnerstags in Berlin. Die restlichen Tage kannst du dir aussuchen, von wo aus du arbeitest. Falls du an den Präsenztagen mal nicht ins Büro kommen kannst, gibt es Jokertage, die du flexibel einsetzen kannst.
  • Tapetenwechsel inklusive - bei Zasta hast du 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und die Möglichkeit, bis zu 4 Wochen am Stück innerhalb Europas zu arbeiten.
Du bist dir nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen für diese Stelle erfüllst? Wir freuen uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bringst du etwas Besonderes in das Team ein, das wir bisher nicht in Betracht gezogen haben.


Dein Kontakt bei Zasta:

Wenn du Fragen zur Stelle hast, kannst du uns jederzeit über  schreiben. Bewerbungen können wir nur online über die Plattform akzeptieren und werden auf anderem Wege nicht beachtet. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu lesen!

data.title: Performance Creative Strategist - Social & Paid (w/m/d)

data.description:
Was du bei uns machen wirst:

TL;DR

Zasta ist die führende Steuer-App in den deutschen App Stores (schau selbst auf deinem Handy in der Kategorie Finanzen nach). 

Wir bauen kein Unternehmen über Headcount auf. Unsere Teams bestehen aus erfahrenen Expert:innen mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem klaren Anspruch an Qualität und Geschwindigkeit.

Wir suchen einen Chief of Staff mit außergewöhnlich hohem Drive und analytischer Stärke, der direkt mit unserem CEO an den wichtigsten strategischen Themen von Zasta arbeitet.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Von Analyse und Business Case über Partnerverhandlung und Scoping bis zu Go-live und messbarem Ergebnis.

  • Top-Profil: Sehr starker akademischer Track Record und typischerweise 3–8 Jahre relevante Erfahrung – z. B. Strategy Consulting + Operator-Rolle, Founders' Office oder General Management.

  • Business-relevante Projekte: Neue Geschäftsmodelle, Partnerschaften, Marketing Channels, regulatorische Themen, Markterweiterungen und andere strategische Initiativen.

  • Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau ist aufgrund unseres regulierten Steuerumfelds zwingend erforderlich.

  • Starkes Gehalt + VSOP, ein klarer Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta (wenn dein Weg dich stattdessen zur eigenen Gründung führt, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit einem Angel-Ticket).

Du bist für relevante strategische Themen von der ersten Idee bis zum messbaren Business Impact verantwortlich.

Achtung: Das ist keine klassische Stabs-, PMO- oder Koordinationsrolle.

Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, schaffst Struktur, entwickelst Business Cases, identifizierst und verhandelst mit Partner:innen und treibst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations bis zum Go-live.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Dinge baut und ins Ziel bringt, anstatt nur Entscheidungsvorlagen zu erarbeiten.

Deine Verantwortung

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO und eng mit dem Management Team an strategisch relevanten Initiativen. Deine Themen sind keine Side Projects. Sie bewegen relevante Line-Items in unserem Business Plan.

Je nach Projekt bedeutet das:

  • neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren, auf Machbarkeit prüfen und umsetzen

  • komplexe, unstrukturierte Probleme in klare Hypothesen, Entscheidungen und Workstreams übersetzen

  • Business Cases und Economics entwickeln und kritisch challengen

  • externe Partner:innen identifizieren, bewerten und kommerzielle Konditionen verhandeln

  • gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations MVPs konzipieren und umsetzen

Wir messen dich nicht daran, wie gut deine Slides sind, sondern daran, ob du reale Probleme löst und messbaren Business Impact schaffst.

Zwei beispielhafte ProjekteEinen neuen Geschäftsbereich aufbauen

Rund um das „Altersvorsorgedepot“ entstehen in Deutschland neue Marktchancen.

Du bewertest, welche Rolle Zasta darin spielen sollte – von einer Affiliate-Partnerschaft bis zu einer tief integrierten Produktlösung.

Markt & Strategie → Business Case → Partner Sourcing → Verhandlung → MVP → Tech-Integration → Go-live

Du entwickelst die Economics, identifizierst geeignete Partner:innen, führst Verhandlungen, bewertest regulatorische und operative Anforderungen und bringst die gewählte Lösung gemeinsam mit Product und Tech in unser Produkt. Ein sauberes „Nein“ ist für uns genauso wertvoll wie ein Go-live – wenn die Economics oder Rahmenbedingungen nicht stimmen.

Einen neuen Marketingkanal erschließen

Wir wollen beispielsweise testen, ob sich Out-of-Home zu einem skalierbaren Performance-Marketing-Kanal für Zasta entwickeln kann (und ja: Wir meinen Performance, nicht nur Brand).

Du entwickelst Business Case und Testsetup, bewertest Anbieter und Inventar, verhandelst Konditionen und bringst die Kampagne gemeinsam mit Marketing und Brand live. Wenn Lukas Podolski Teil des Test-Setups sein soll, bekommen wir auch das hin. Anschließend entscheiden wir anhand klarer KPIs: Scale, iterate or stop.

Weitere Projekte können neue Partnerschaften, Pricing, regulatorische Themen, operative Skalierung, M&A, neue Produkte, Vertriebskanäle, vollständig neue Geschäftsmodelle oder interne Strukturen betreffen.


Was du idealerweise mitbringst:

Wir suchen eine außergewöhnlich starke Kombination aus analytischer Exzellenz, Geschwindigkeit und Ownership.

Du bringst mit:

  • einen sehr guten akademischen Track Record und einen sehr guten Abschluss von einer führenden Universität

  • typischerweise 3–8 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung

  • außergewöhnlich starke analytische und strukturierte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten

  • die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell und tief in neue und komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten

  • sehr gutes quantitatives und kommerzielles Urteilsvermögen

  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit Gründer:innen, Senior Stakeholdern, Führungskräften und externen Partner:innen

  • einen sehr hohen Anspruch an Qualität und Geschwindigkeit sowie einen starken Bias for Action

Wenn du ein Problem siehst, wartest du nicht auf Zuständigkeiten. Du übernimmst Ownership, schaffst Klarheit und bringst die Lösung ins Ziel.

Exzellentes Deutsch ist zwingend erforderlich

Du sprichst Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte sprachlich präzise erfassen, formulieren und verhandeln.

Das ist für uns keine formale Anforderung: Zasta bewegt sich in einem stark regulierten Umfeld rund um Steuerberatung, Finanzprozesse und Verbraucherschutz. In vielen Fragestellungen kommt es auf juristische, steuerliche oder regulatorische Nuancen der deutschen Sprache an.

Du musst in der Lage sein, diese selbstständig zu verstehen, kritisch zu hinterfragen und präzise mit Steuerberater:innen, Partner:innen, Anwält:innen, Behörden und internen Teams zu kommunizieren.


Was wir dir bieten:

  • starkes Gehalt + VSOP

  • direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CEO und Management Team

  • außergewöhnlich viel Verantwortung und Entscheidungsspielraum

  • kurze Wege von einer guten Idee zur tatsächlichen Umsetzung

  • einen bewussten Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta

Wir suchen keinen Career Chief of Staff. Wir suchen einen zukünftigen Business Owner.

Im besten Fall übernimmst du nach dieser Rolle einen relevanten Teil des Unternehmens selbst – als Business Owner, VP oder in einer anderen Leadership-Funktion.

Und dein Weg muss nicht bei Zasta enden:

Wir würden uns freuen, wenn wir dich in einigen Jahren bei der Gründung deines eigenen Unternehmens mit einem Angel-Ticket unterstützen könnten.

Warum wir?

  • Verantwortungsvolle Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und Perspektive zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung

  • Moderne Arbeitsplätze in zentraler Lage in Düsseldorf (Golzheim) mit einer idealen ÖPNV-Anbindung

Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


🌏 Location: You can choose to work in Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.
 
Mission: Join us as a Frontend Engineer to craft the web apps that 600,000+ European SMEs rely on every day, from the customer-facing features that make finance simpler to the design system powering every pixel of our product.

➡️ As a Frontend Engineer at Qonto, you will

  • Craft new features for our customers within a squad Team, owning quality from design to production.
  • Grow in technical leadership: lead design discussions, contribute to guild-wide improvement, and raise the bar for developer experience across your peers
  • Be a key player in teamwork with Product, Design, and other Tech stacks
  • Work AI-first: use AI as a default part of how you explore the codebase, draft technical designs, prototype solutions, and accelerate delivery, while keeping strong human judgment and quality standards

➡️  What you can expect: our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • At Qonto, we value diversity and are proud to have 33% non-male in our Frontend guild.
  • You will contribute to and use our own design system and UI library, which we built from scratch.
  • You will be part of a team that is driven by quality. Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates
  • You will have access to best-in-class AI tools (e.g., Claude / Claude Code and internal workflows) and the autonomy to experiment, share learnings, and help scale what works across the guild
  • You will bring your energy and skills to improve the team’s tools and processes at many levels, contributing to a better developer experience for all your peers.
You can watch this interview of Imen, who joined the team as a Lead in January 2023.
 

➡️  Your future team

As a Frontend Engineer, you'll join one of Qonto's squad teams, each with a clear project mission, one team lead, and full product ownership.
You'll be part of a 100+ strong Frontend community within a 500+ Product Engineering department, working in teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Backend and Mobile.
 
We hold ourselves to high standards, and we've shipped several open-source JS libraries along the way. We almost completed a migration to React. Now is an exciting time to join, especially if you want to hone your expertise in React over the coming years!

➡️ About You

To succeed as a Frontend Engineer at Qonto, you will need to demonstrate:
  1. Proficiency in frontend engineering: you have at least three years of professional experience using React.js, as well as HTML and CSS. We don’t use CSS libraries such as Tailwind, so you will need to know how to write pure CSS.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

Wir suchen einen engagierten IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d), der unser dynamisches Team verstärkt und mit Begeisterung die IT-Infrastruktur unserer Kunden weiter entwickelt.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgabe bei uns

Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unserem Technik-Team.

Wenn ein Kunde eine Störung meldet, Unterstützung benötigt oder einen neuen Auftrag erteilt, sorgst Du dafür, dass das Thema strukturiert aufgenommen, priorisiert und an den richtigen Techniker weitergegeben wird.

Dabei behältst Du offene Vorgänge im Blick und stellst sicher, dass unsere Kunden zuverlässig informiert und betreut werden.

Dein Ziel: Der Kunde weiß, dass wir uns kümmern – und unsere Techniker wissen, was wann zu tun ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Annahme und Koordination von Kundenanfragen, Störungen und Aufträgen
  • Persönliche und telefonische Betreuung unserer Bestandskunden
  • Erfassen, Priorisieren und Nachverfolgen von Service-Tickets
  • Einschätzung der Dringlichkeit und Priorität von Störungen
  • Koordination und Einsatzplanung unserer IT-Techniker
  • Zuordnung von Aufgaben zum passenden technischen Mitarbeiter
  • Überwachung von offenen Tickets, Terminen und zugesagten Rückmeldungen
  • Aktive Kommunikation mit Kunden über den aktuellen Bearbeitungsstand
  • Erkennen von Eskalationen und rechtzeitiges Gegensteuern
  • Abstimmung zwischen Kunde, Technik, Vertrieb und Backoffice
  • Vorbereitung und Koordination kleinerer IT-Aufträge und Projekte
  • Kontrolle, ob Aufträge und Störungen vollständig abgeschlossen und dokumentiert wurden
  • Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Serviceprozesse

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Du musst kein tiefgehender IT-Spezialist sein.

Du solltest aber ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis besitzen und einschätzen können, ob beispielsweise ein ausgefallener Server, eine Firewall-Störung oder ein nicht funktionierender Arbeitsplatz unterschiedliche Prioritäten benötigen.

Noch wichtiger sind für uns:

Organisation, Verbindlichkeit, Kommunikation und Eigeninitiative.

Du wartest nicht darauf, dass jemand nach einem Vorgang fragt, sondern behältst selbstständig den Überblick und kümmerst Dich darum, dass Themen weitergehen.

Qualifikation

Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Freude an Kundenkontakt und Kommunikation
  • Ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung
  • Sehr gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten
  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Verbindlichkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
  • Fähigkeit, mehrere Vorgänge gleichzeitig zu koordinieren
  • Ruhe und Übersicht auch bei dringenden Störungen
  • Grundverständnis für IT und technische Zusammenhänge
  • Erfahrung in einem IT-Systemhaus, IT-Support oder technischen Service ist von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen, Helpdesk oder Einsatzplanung ist ebenfalls von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten IT-Unternehmen
  • Vielfältige und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabenbereiche
  • Flache Hierarchiestrukturen und effiziente Entscheidungsprozesse
  • Gezielte Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung und professionelle IT-Infrastruktur
  • Attraktive Vergütung sowie ein engagiertes und professionelles Team

Wer wir sind

Die OESTMANN GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes IT-Systemhaus aus Hamburg.

Seit über 50 Jahren unterstützen wir Unternehmen bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Betreuung ihrer IT.

Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen unter anderem in den Bereichen IT-Infrastruktur, Server- und Cloud-Lösungen, Microsoft 365, Netzwerk und WLAN, IT-Sicherheit, Firewall, Managed Security, Backup und Recovery sowie persönlichem IT-Support.

Wir verstehen uns nicht nur als IT-Lieferant, sondern als langfristiger IT-Partner unserer Kunden.

Unser Anspruch ist es, Probleme nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern sie aktiv zu lösen und möglichst zu verhindern, bevor sie entstehen.

Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

Location

This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich, the role will be based remotely or hybrid from Germany or Austria. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by blp.

 

About the role

As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you'll operate at the intersection of business and tech, leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You'll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.

 

What you'll do

  • Own the implementation journey end-to-end, from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

  • Translate complexity into clarity: design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

  • Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers' unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

  • Be the client's trusted partner: anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp's automation.

  • Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

  • Feed the product loop: surface what isn't working and translate that feedback into long-term platform improvements.

 

What you'll bring

Key attributes for success

  • Ownership and autonomy. You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

  • Managing ambiguity. You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

  • Growth mindset. You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

  • Problem solving and critical thinking. You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

  • Customer-first mentality. You think beyond implementation and care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills: you can translate business needs into technical action.

  • Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

  • Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus.

  • Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

 

What you'll get

  • High ownership environment. You shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale. Your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure. Work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth. Fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership. Be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team. Become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure. Be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits and offsites. Paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

About the role

We're hiring a Strategic Value Engineer (Presales) to shape and win enterprise ERP automation decisions: you reframe problems, quantify the cost of inaction, and prove value through tailored workshops and demos. Partnering with an AE, you own technical leadership, value articulation, and de-risking security/integration, building alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees.

 

What you'll own

Insight-led discovery and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing, introduce a sharper point of view on where value is actually trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls), and reframe urgency using cost-of-inaction.

  • Lead discovery across CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate that into a crisp target-state narrative and mutual action plan.

Solution design and technical leadership

  • Architect a tailored solution: scope, rollout approach, integration pattern, security posture, and success criteria.

  • Run deep dives with IT/security and articulate how blp works in enterprise environments (ERP digital twin, data synchronization, governance and controls).

Demos, workshops, and executive storytelling

  • Deliver high-impact demos that map to customer workflows (P2P, AP, S2P) and prove outcomes, not features.

  • Facilitate workshops that turn stakeholder skepticism into a tangible blueprint and path to value.

Value engineering (business case support)

  • Build a credible value narrative: labor productivity gains, cycle time reduction, compliance/control improvements, and stack simplification.

  • Support champions and the AE with executive-ready business-case inputs, impact ranges, and rollout economics, flagging risk to the deal early rather than late.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Help the deal team land a clear "why now" anchored in operational risk, ERP program success, and enterprise scale requirements.

 

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 3–8+ years in Value Engineering / Presales / Solution Consulting / ERP process consulting (or equivalent in finance/procurement operations with strong customer-facing chops).

  • Demonstrated ability to run insight-based discovery (Challenger-style): you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and build conviction across a buying committee.

  • Comfort with senior stakeholders (CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services): you can lead without authority.

  • Strong workshop facilitation and demo craft: story, structure, and objection handling.

  • Ability to connect technical realities to business outcomes (FTE capacity, cycle time, controls, compliance risk, TCO).

Strong plus

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

  • Finance/process knowledge: AP, invoice processing, S2P/P2P, exception handling, approvals, master data workflows.

  • Experience competing against legacy vendors and "patchwork stacks."

Language

  • Fluent in English and another major European language, preferably German, depending on territory.

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

📍 München / Frankfurt | Hybrid + Kundenreisen

Du verstehst AI nicht nur technisch, sondern kannst daraus überzeugende Lösungen für Kunden entwickeln, komplexe Themen auf C-Level erklären und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten mitgestalten?

Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes internationales Technologie- und Beratungsunternehmen mit starker Präsenz in den Bereichen Daten, KI und digitale Transformation, das mit großen Unternehmen aus den Branchen Automobil, Fertigung, Pharma, Gesundheitswesen, Einzelhandel und Finanzdienstleistungen zusammenarbeitet. Das Unternehmen investiert derzeit massiv in GenAI, LLMs, agentische KI und intelligente Automatisierung, und diese Position wird entscheidenden Einfluss darauf haben, wie sich das KI-Geschäft des Unternehmens in Deutschland entwickelt.

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du die AI-Aktivitäten im deutschen Markt maßgeblich mit. Du arbeitest eng mit Enterprise-Kunden, lokalen Sales-Teams und einer internationalen AI Practice zusammen und führst gleichzeitig ein erfahrenes AI-Team in Deutschland.

Was dich erwartet

• Leitung von AI-Presales-Aktivitäten und strategischen Kundengesprächen
• Entwicklung von AI-, GenAI- und LLM-Lösungen aus konkreten Business-Anforderungen
• Präsentationen, Workshops und Solution Discussions mit Senior- und C-Level-Stakeholdern
• Unterstützung bei Pitches, Proposals, RFPs und Solution Architecture
• Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines erfahrenen AI-Teams
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen AI- und Data-Experten
• Mitgestaltung neuer AI-Angebote, Use Cases und Business Opportunities
• Repräsentation des Unternehmens bei Kunden, Events und Fachveranstaltungen


Fundierte Erfahrung in AI, Machine Learning, GenAI und LLMs
• Erfahrung im Consulting, Presales oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle
• Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Themen in klaren Business Value zu übersetzen
• Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Kunden, idealerweise in Manufacturing, Automotive, Pharma, Retail oder Financial Services
• Leadership-Erfahrung oder ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung
• Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem bzw. nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau
• Professionelles Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen, globalen Umfeld
• Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Kundenterminen und Reisen

Besonders interessant sind Profile aus AI Consulting, Data Science, Solution Architecture, Value Engineering oder AI Practice Leadership.

Gesucht wird keine rein technische Führungskraft, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die AI versteht, Kunden überzeugt und Technologie in konkrete Geschäftsmöglichkeiten übersetzen kann.

data.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
As our Head of Supply Chain UK you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do
  • Build and own Hypersonica’s UK supply chain capability from first principles, establishing a secure, resilient, and execution focused procurement function for complex aerospace hardware.
  • Lead sourcing and contracting across long lead, highly regulated propulsion and flight critical subsystems, ensuring schedule integrity under demanding national security constraints.
  • Develop and qualify a trusted supplier network across advanced materials, precision fabrication, high performance electronics, military grade avionics, and specialist manufacturing partners.
  • Negotiate and structure commercial agreements that balance cost, schedule, export controls, and security requirements within a UK defence acquisition environment.
  • Establish supplier onboarding, audit, and performance management frameworks aligned with aerospace quality standards and future AS9100 certification.
  • Work directly with engineering to translate technical requirements into executable procurement strategies, managing configuration changes and rapid iteration without compromising compliance.
  • Build the operational backbone of UK procurement: processes, tools, documentation discipline, and supplier risk management in a fast scaling defence start up.
  • Serve as the primary UK interface for controlled components, export considerations, and sensitive supply chain pathways, ensuring resilience against geopolitical and regulatory disruption.

    • Who you are
  • An experienced aerospace or defence supply chain leader who has owned procurement of complex, high consequence hardware programmes.
  • Comfortable sourcing long lead propulsion adjacent systems, flight critical electronics, and military grade subsystems within tightly controlled regulatory environments.
  • Experienced operating under export control and UK national security frameworks, with strong instincts for compliance and discretion.
  • Proven in building supplier networks from scratch or transforming immature procurement functions into disciplined, scalable systems.
  • Commercially sharp and technically literate, able to challenge engineering assumptions while protecting schedule and cost.
  • Calm under pressure, capable of securing critical supply in constrained markets where availability and reliability matter more than price alone.
  • Energised by building something from nothing in a small, elite team where supply chain performance directly determines mission success.
  • Motivated by sovereign capability and the responsibility that comes with delivering nationally significant defence hardware.

    • What we offer
  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.
    • At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
     
    Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
     
    You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

What you'll do

  • Develop avionics assembly, integration, and test procedures directly from requirements and engineering drawings. 

  • Translate design intent into clear, executable build instructions, defining tooling, torque specifications, parts, consumables, work sequences, and verification steps.

  • Develop and own avionics assembly procedures for components, sub‑assemblies, and vehicle‑level integration. 

  • Create and execute avionics test procedures, validating functionality, interfaces, and readiness prior to higher‑level integration. 

  • Ensure avionics AIT activities meet quality, reliability, and safety standards, suitable for aerospace and defence environments. 

  • Work closely with avionics design, systems, and vehicle AIT teams to resolve integration issues and close design‑for‑integration gaps.

Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice. Accuracy is the bar for both: in finance, 99% right is wrong, so every automation ships with the checks and reconciliations that prove its output.

What You'll Do

  • Run core finance processes: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges. Learn them, run them, own them.
  • Automate them: with Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub and the Soda MCP, or with smart spreadsheet design when that is the better tool.
  • Build in the checks: reconciliations and controls in everything you automate, so the output is verified before anyone else has to look at it.
  • Document as you go: process documentation that a colleague and an AI agent can both follow.
  • Support the wider Finance team: reporting, analysis, and ad-hoc projects across our Belgian and US entities.

Hiring Process

1.      Application with a few short questions

2.      Recorded video interview (3 questions, in your own time)

3.      20-minute interview

4.      Take-home assignment (plan for 5-6 hours)

5.      45-minute deep dive on your assignment

6.      Final interview

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

•     A finance background: studying towards or recently completed a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

•     Proof that you build: you've used AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) and/or built automations, scripts, or advanced spreadsheet solutions, and you can show us one and explain how you checked its output.

•     Accuracy as a habit: you're the person who notices the 780 that should have been 800, and you don't sign off on numbers you haven't verified.

•     Independent with new tools: you can pick up GitHub, MCP-based integrations, and finance systems without a course.

•     Proactive: you spot the manual work and come with a plan for it. You'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.

•     Fluent English, written and spoken.

•     European business hours: fully remote from any compatible time zone, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

Good to Have

•     Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact Online, QuickBooks) or ERP systems.

•     Exposure to Python, SQL, or API-based automation.

•     Prior startup or fast-paced work experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

•     €1,250 - €1,750 per month, depending on experience.

•     A clear path to a permanent role if you perform: 3-month contractor engagement first, extended as it works.

•     Fully remote and flexible working, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

•     All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.

•     Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. This is not a coffee-and-observe internship - you operate as part of the Finance team.

•     Start: As soon as possible, aiming for the beginning of October 2026

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

•     You own processes, not tickets: what you automate is yours to design, and behind it is a list of things nobody here has built yet.

•     Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.

•     Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.

•     International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.

•     Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

•     Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.

•     Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

 

Join us to elevate our finance team to the next level!

Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own content at Soda, end to end.

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues.

The Role

The website. Technical blogs, webinars, and product videos. Your own content and following.

One person cannot hand-make all of that. So you'll build the system that can. That isn't a stretch goal or a second phase - we don't think the job exists without it.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself. Content engineer, technical content marketer, growth engineer, marketing engineer, GTM engineer, developer advocate, technical writer who got bored, or nothing in particular. We've seen this job posted under every one of those. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to be able to write and you need to be able to build, and almost nobody can do both.

Why this is a real problem and not a content calendar. The expertise is already in the building. Founders who have argued about this category for a decade. Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. Almost none of it gets written down, and what does get out is hand-made, one piece at a time, by people who have other jobs. Your job is to get it out of their heads and onto the internet, at a volume that is only possible with a machine behind it.

Taste is the bar. Anti-slop is the whole point. An engine that ships slop faster has negative value, and most of them do. We're hiring for the judgment to look at an accurate, competent, lifeless draft and bin it - then work out what the pipeline did wrong and fix it. The engine has to write in distinct voices: a founder sounds nothing like a customer engineer, and the output should sound like them, not like a model. Your own profile and following is part of how we'll know it works. If it can't make you sound good, it won't make anyone else sound good either.

What this is not. You'll write code every day, but this is not a software engineering job. We're not hiring you to build product, and if you're a backend, data, or platform engineer looking for your next engineering role, this isn't it. It's also not a traditional marketing or DevRel role: no agency to brief and no conference circuit.

Requirements

  • You can write, and you can tell good writing from bad: send us something you wrote that a technical audience actually read. The most important line in this ad.
  • Serious prompt engineering: multi-step LLM pipelines with structured outputs and evals, not chatting with a model. You know why the naive version produces slop.
  • 3+ years building things that go to market: technical content, growth engineering, marketing engineering, GTM engineering, DevRel, marketing ops, RevOps, or a founder background. Nobody agrees what to call this job yet. Titles vary; portfolios don't.
  • Enough code to be autonomous: Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, a database. Nothing should be blocked waiting for an engineer. We build agentically here - Claude Code, MCP servers, and agent skills are the daily workflow.
  • Enough data fluency to be credible: you're writing for Staff Data Engineers and CDOs. You can hold your own on pipelines, data quality, and warehouses.
  • Generalist instinct: you find the constraint and fix it, and you'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • You've grown a technical audience of your own: newsletter, blog, LinkedIn, open source, YouTube.
  • Content, growth, or DevRel in data, developer tools, or infrastructure.
  • Agentic workflows shipped to real users: MCP servers, Claude skills, tool-using agents.
  • You can shoot and cut video yourself.
  • Data quality, data management, or data observability industry experience.

Benefits

  • Compensation: $120,000-$130,000 / €110,000-€120,000 per year + equity - the same band wherever you live. We don't discount for geography.
  • Fully remote (US or EU-based), with offices in Brooklyn if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • Colleagues in 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.
  • Paid the same wherever you are: one band for the US and Europe, no geographic discount.
  • Your name on the work: you build your own audience on company time, and we want you to.
  • Direct line to the founders: how Soda talks about the category gets decided with you in the room.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.
  • You will kill a lot of your own output: accurate and lifeless still goes in the bin.
  • Judged on output, not architecture: an elegant pipeline nobody reads from is a failure.

Hiring Process

  1. 15-minute phone screen - with a founder
  2. Short Assignment
  3. Craft deep dive (90 min)
  4. Culture fit (1 hour)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Deine Mission

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir für unseren Standort Berlin einen erfahrenen Senior Elektroingenieur (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Analogelektronik und Messtechnik, der mit seinem Know-how unsere Mess- und Inspektionstechnologie technisch weiter voranbringt.

EMPIT ist ein wachsendes Deep-Tech-Unternehmen, das Mess- und Inspektionssysteme für den internationalen Einsatz an kritischer Infrastruktur entwickelt. Mit unseren Technologien machen wir sichtbar, was sonst verborgen bleibt, und leisten damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit kritischer Infrastruktur.

In deiner Rolle entwickelst und optimierst du die Elektronik hinter diesen Systemen – von leistungsfähigen Stromversorgungen und Platinen bis hin zur Neukonzeption einzelner Komponenten unserer Signalgeneratoren. Dabei entstehen Lösungen, die kompakt, zuverlässig und für den internationalen Einsatz ausgelegt sind. 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Stromversorgungen weiterentwickeln: Leistungsfähigkeit, Effizienz und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Stromquellen verbessern und auf die Anforderungen unserer Messsysteme abstimmen.
  • Platinen und elektronische Baugruppen entwickeln: Schaltungen aufbauen, Prototypen in Betrieb nehmen, Messergebnisse bewerten und bestehende Hardware gezielt optimieren.
  • Elektronik kompakter machen: Bestehende Baugruppen hinsichtlich Größe, Gewicht und Aufbau optimieren, damit unsere Systeme sicher und effizient transportiert werden können – auch per Flugzeug.
  • Signalgeneratoren neu denken: Bestehende Komponenten analysieren, technische Grenzen hinterfragen und neue Lösungen für unsere Signalgeneratoren und Messsysteme entwickeln.
  • Technische Herausforderungen lösen: Fehler systematisch analysieren, Ursachen identifizieren und eigenständig praxistaugliche Lösungen bis zur Umsetzung bringen.
  • Technologie mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit unserem Team neue Konzepte entwickeln und technische Entscheidungen für die nächste Generation unserer Mess- und Inspektionssysteme vorantreiben.


Was Du bei uns bekommst

Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr.

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. 

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. 

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.
