N2F : gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs)

Keeple : gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail)

L’entreprise est en forte croissance avec une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Notre écosystème d’outils s’est construit progressivement avec la croissance de l’entreprise. Il est aujourd’hui riche mais encore insuffisamment structuré :

  • des outils qui ne communiquent pas toujours efficacement entre eux

  • des données encore partiellement silotées

  • certains processus insuffisamment maîtrisés

  • un potentiel d’automatisation et d’usage de l’IA encore peu exploité

Certaines briques sont déjà portées en interne, mais de manière partielle ou trop manuelle.

Nous créons ce poste pour structurer durablement le SI, fiabiliser les flux et accompagner la montée en maturité de l’organisation.

Ton rôle

Rattaché au CTO, tu interviens de manière transverse sur l’ensemble de l’entreprise.

Le poste est volontairement hybride : à la fois stratégique et opérationnel. L’objectif n’est pas uniquement de piloter, mais de comprendre, structurer et mettre en œuvre.

Tu travailles en lien étroit avec le CODIR et les équipes métiers.

  • Concevoir et faire évoluer les intégrations entre les systèmes

L’objectif est d’éliminer les silos et de fiabiliser les échanges de données.

Reprise en main des sujets critiques

  • Monter en compétence sur les outils clés, notamment la facturation

  • Fiabiliser les processus existants

  • Réduire la dépendance aux tâches manuelles via l’automatisation

  • Encadrer une équipe de 3 développeurs

  • Prioriser les sujets en fonction des enjeux business

  • Structurer le backlog et assurer l’alignement avec les besoins de l’entreprise

Développement des usages IA

  • Identifier des cas d’usage concrets avec les équipes

  • Prototyper et déployer des solutions

  • Accompagner l’adoption


Ce que tu apportes

  • Une expérience en environnement SaaS (idéalement dans des structures de 200 à 500 personnes)

  • Une bonne maîtrise des problématiques d’intégration et de flux de données (API, webhooks, synchronisation)

  • Une capacité à comprendre, challenger et structurer un écosystème d’outils dans sa globalité

  • Une expérience avec des outils d’automatisation (Make, Zapier, n8n ou équivalent)

  • Une capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec des interlocuteurs métiers variés

This is a field position. 

About the Position

The Channel Account Manager (CAM) responsibilities include working within the sales team to promote and sell network security products within a geographic territory. The CAM is responsible for supporting assigned WatchGuard partners in the assigned territory and will be responsible for active channel partners. The CAM will be responsible for quoting, training, lead generation and follow-up, event support, and the forecasting and tracking for their assigned partners. The CAM will report to the Country Manager, working closely to assure territory quota attainment, in addition to joining with the sales and field marketing teams in the territory. Success in this position will be measured by meeting successful transaction, growth, and retention goals with the assigned partners. The CAM will keep up-to-date knowledge of the industry and the competitive posture of the company, as well as prepare activity and forecast reports as requested.


Position Responsibilities

· Strive towards the territory quota attainment, retention, and growth/development of active partners

· Maintain regular contact with partners to ensure satisfaction and continued success

· Partner with Territory Channel Account Manager to generate new business and develop current customers through the partner network

· Support partners on standard methodologies and use of WatchGuard, including training, event support, and lead generation

· Create and perform sales presentations to match WatchGuard with audience needs

· Provide ongoing relationship management and training for partners

· Net growth for WatchGuard One Certifications in the territory

· Be knowledgeable of all WatchGuard products, services, and internal sales tools

· Other duties and projects assigned


Skills and Qualifications

· Experience with two-tier/channel sales ecosystem required

· Experience in network/cyber security space preferred

· History of sales experience with partner accounts

· History of consistent plan development and quota achievement

· Strong presentation and written skills

· Ability to self-manage and work remotely

· Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM


Experience

· 2+ years’ experience in direct and indirect sales in related industry

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent training in business, sales, or marketing.


Why Work for WatchGuard?

WatchGuard is a global leader in network security and intelligence, advanced endpoint protection, multi-factor authentication, and secure Wi-Fi. Our award-winning products and services are trusted worldwide by more than 18,000 security resellers and service providers to protect more than 250,000 customers. Our technology keeps our customers ahead of increasingly sophisticated hackers and has fueled record revenues at WatchGuard.

WatchGuard is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with team members working remotely and in offices worldwide.

Our company culture places an intense focus on our customers and employees. From the newest employee to our CEO, you'll find that each person at WatchGuard embodies our Core Values:

Accountability, Community, Belonging, Action, Innovation, and Customer-Centric. Learn more about our company culture at www.watchguard.com/wgrd-careers.

WatchGuard provides equal employment opportunities for all qualified employees, regardless of their race, color, national origin, religion, ancestry, creed, pregnancy, age, sex, sexual orientation (including gender expression or identity), marital status, mental or physical disability, honorably discharged veteran or military status or any other category protected by federal, state or local laws. Our equal employment opportunity (or EEO) policy focuses solely on the talent, hard work, contributions, and actual results achieved by each WatchGuard employee and on the potential of employment candidates to make such contributions. We consider focusing on an employee's protected characteristics rather than on talent, hard work, and actual work results to violate our EEO policy. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to a diverse workforce. WatchGuard participates in E-verify.

WatchGuard is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Solution Innovation Analyst, you will be the operational backbone of the Solution Innovation Center. You will support Account Executives and the wider GTM organisation with the day-to-day mechanics of getting RFPs, security reviews, and questionnaires completed accurately and on time, and help keep our Consensus demo automation platform and video content pipeline running smoothly. You will work cross-functionally on a regular basis, partnering with teams such as Legal and Security to get responses reviewed and signed off. This is an entry level or early career role within the Solution Innovation Center, based in our Paris office, ideal for someone looking to build a foundation in presales operations and grow into broader Solutions Consulting responsibilities.


What we offer
  • Competitive package
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue, entirely free for you and your family 
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • A Learning Stipend per year, for you to develop into areas that amplify impact for your careers or personal development
  • Remote work stipend to have the best work station possible at home
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions

    • What You'll Do:

    RFP Operational Support

    • Intake & Triage – Support the SC team and wider GTM organisation with the operational processes around incoming RFPs, prioritising and routing requests appropriately.

    • Document Handling – Manage the upload, formatting, and export of RFP documents, ensuring AEs and SCs have what they need in the right format and on time.

    • Platform & User Administration – Administer user access and permissions within Ombud, Pigment's RFP tooling, keeping the platform running smoothly for the wider GTM team and becoming a go-to resource for basic platform questions.

    • Status Tracking – Keep RFP trackers and dashboards current so that the GTM Org and leadership always have visibility into RFP performance.

      • Infosec Questionnaire Support

      • Technical SC Partnership – Work closely with the Technical Solution Consulting team to respond to Infosec questionnaires, coordinating inputs and ensuring responses are submitted accurately and on time.

      • Question Routing – Triage incoming Infosec questions, handling standard items directly from the answer library and routing anything technical to the Technical SC team.

        • Demo Automation Platform Administration (Consensus)

        • User Administration – Manage user access and permissions within Consensus, Pigment's demo automation platform.

        • Content Administration – Organise, tag, and maintain content within Consensus so that demo videos and Interactive Product Tours stay current and easy for the field to find.

          • Content Creation & Video Editing (Descript)

          • Content Support – Support the creation of demo videos and other digital content, using Descript to edit and produce assets for the Video demo library.

            • Cross-Functional Coordination

            • GTM Partnership – Act as a responsive point of contact for AEs on RFP status, timelines, and next steps.

            • Legal & Security Coordination – Work cross-functionally with teams such as Legal and Security to route questions, gather input, and get RFP and Infosec responses reviewed and signed off.

            • CSM Coordination – Support Post-Sales teams with the administrative steps of security and infosec review requests, routing them to the right owner.


    Who You Are:

    • Experience: Entry level or early career (1-3 years).  Some experience in the software industry or operational experience in an industry setting would be an advantage. No prior presales experience required.

    • Location & Language: Based in our Paris office, with fluency in English required.

    • Organised & Detail-Oriented: Comfortable managing multiple requests at once, with a strong eye for accuracy and consistency in written material.  You must be able to work under pressure and manage tight deadlines.

    • Process-Minded: Enjoys bringing structure and reliability to operational workflows, and takes ownership of the tasks in front of them.

    • Proactive Communicator: Openly communicates status, roadblocks, and concerns with the SIC team and stakeholders across GTM.

    • Coachable: Takes ownership of individual learning, asks questions, and seeks support on assigned tasks as they ramp.

    • AI-Proficient: Comfortable using AI tools to automate process workflows and improve day-to-day efficiency, and keen to keep exploring new ways AI can streamline operational work.

    • Collaborative: Works well within the SIC team and with outside teams (AEs, Post-Sales, Legal, Security, Product) when called upon.


    How We Work:

    • Thrive Together:  We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet

    • Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day.  Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community

    • Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission

    • Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll do
  • As the Financial Consolidation Solutions Consulting Domain Lead, you will drive the pre-sales go-to-market strategy for Financial Consolidation across EMEA. Your primary responsibility is to position Pigment as the trusted partner for prospects and customers in Financial Consolidation and FP&A. In this role, you will lead strategic pre-sales engagements, develop compelling demo assets, enable the broader Solution Consulting (SC) team, and collaborate closely with the product team to enhance our solution offering.
  • Own pre-sales engagements for strategic, high-value accounts with complex consolidation needs.
  • Deliver tailored solution presentations addressing key challenges in Financial Consolidation, intercompany eliminations, and regulatory compliance, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
  • Provide deep technical and functional expertise for complex opportunities, particularly in IFRS, GAAP, multi-entity reporting, and compliance-driven scenarios.
  • Develop and deliver impactful demos that highlight Pigment’s capabilities in financial consolidation, reporting, and compliance. Extend these to FP&A use cases to expand Pigment’s presence in the Office of the CFO.
  • Work with the Solutions Innovation Center to maintain and enhance the demo library for Financial Consolidation, Close, and Reporting.
  • Oversee the creation, refinement, and maintenance of demo scripts, video assets, and Interactive Product Tours to ensure relevance and impact for financial executives, CFOs, and consolidation teams.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop thought leadership content, including webinars, whitepapers, and industry insights focused on financial consolidation and compliance.

    • Who you are
  • Strong background in finance & accounting.  Experience as a consolidation accountant, financial controller, or auditor, with hands-on exposure to statutory and management consolidation.
  • Proven experience with Financial Consolidation (FC) tools, such as Oracle HFM, Oracle FCCS, SAP Financial Consolidation (fka Cartesis) / Group Reporting/ BPC, OneStream, Fluence, or Tagetik.
  • Experience with other EPM solutions, Close Management Solutions, and/or Disclosure Management solutions is a plus.
  • Background in pre-sales (Solution Consulting) at a SaaS/software company or finance transformation, with a strong record of engaging finance teams in adopting consolidation solutions.
  • Strong understanding of legal and management consolidation, intercompany eliminations, IFRS/local GAAP compliance, cash flow reporting, and audit requirements.
  • Understanding of non financial reporting requirements (CSRD, Pilar 2 tax reporting, etc…)
  • BA/BS in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; DSCG or DEC (or UK equivalents) preferred.
  • Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.
    •  

    What we offer
  • Competitive package
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family 
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
  • Remote-friendly environment

    • How we work
  • Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
  • Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
  • Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
  • Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment
  • Champion our Customers: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our Customers heroes in their organizations

Join Pigment: Transforming Business Planning and Performance with AI  
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment stands out as one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, redefining business planning and performance with our AI-powered platform. We empower organizations across diverse industries, including Consumer Packaged Goods, Retail, and Technology, to seamlessly integrate data, people, and processes, enabling them to plan and adapt rapidly.  
 
With a vibrant team of over 500 professionals across North America and Europe, and offices in Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, Pigment has successfully secured nearly $400 million in funding from leading global venture capitalists. Our recognition as a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software underscores our commitment to excellence, as we proudly partner with industry leaders like Unilever, Vinci, Kayak, Siemens, and Coca-Cola.  
 
At Pigment, we champion smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all as a united team. Every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact and tackle ambitious challenges. Together, we pursue excellence with a collaborative spirit, continuously raising the bar to ensure strong performance and a proactive approach while fostering an environment of humility.  
 
If you are passionate about innovation and wish to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry, we would love to hear from you!

We are hiring an Optimisation AI Scientist to own the technical delivery of Pigment's solver pilot programme and build the foundations of a production-grade optimisation capability - moving customers from descriptive planning to prescriptive, solver-driven decision-making.

This role is partially customer-facing: leading and shaping the formulation of each client's optimisation problem, directly involved in implementations.

What you will do:

  • Formulate supply chain optimisation problems as rigorous mathematical models - objective functions, costs, penalties, and constraints

  • Configure and run optimisation models for customer pilots and implementation, and support Solutions Architects in delivering results and debriefs

  • Build and run Python models against third-party solvers across multiple dataset scales, and benchmark results across use cases

  • Work with Engineering and Data Science leads to define the path to production-grade solver integration and customer specific implementations within Pigment's architecture

  • Engage technically with solver vendor teams during partnership evaluation

Who you are and what you can do:

  • Demonstrable experience formulating and solving optimisation problems for real-world operational use cases

  • Proficiency in Python with hands-on experience in a major solver library (Gurobi, OR-Tools, CPLEX, HiGHS, or equivalent)

  • Experience with supply chain/operations data — SKUs, BOMs, capacity constraints, service levels, lead times, inventory targets etc.

  • Understanding of core OR techniques: branch-and-bound, LP relaxation, constraint programming, sensitivity analysis

  • Degree in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, CS, or related field (MS/PhD advantageous)

Role Overview

We’re building category-defining AI products for Finance, Planning and Operations professionals and the market is moving fast. Pigment is looking for a Head of Brand Marketing to serve as a key architect of our brand’s long-term evolution.

We're hiring a Head of Brand Marketing to own how Pigment shows up in the world: visually, verbally, culturally, and emotionally. You'll be the senior leader most responsible for what Pigment feels like in a keynote, on a billboard, in a product launch film, on a t-shirt at a conference. The goal isn't brand-as-decoration. It's a compounding advantage: the reason a great engineer or sales leader joins us over a competitor, the reason a CFO remembers our name in a procurement meeting, the reason a journalist picks up our story.


What you'll do:
  • You work closely with the CMO and senior leadership on the brand's long-term evolution. 
  • Bring the brand to life in a way that is clear, compelling, and deeply customer-centered, championing bold ideas and high standards, translating strategy into stories and experiences
  • You’ll build a brand with a real point of view. Not one that hedges toward consensus.
  • You’ll own Pigment's visual and creative identity. That means making calls on direction and driving consistency in execution across every customer touchpoint.
  • Own the development and governance of naming and nomenclature across products and experiences, ensuring a clear, consistent, connected brand system
  • Lead the creation of compelling brand stories, campaigns, and narratives that emotionally connect users with Pigments purpose.
  • You lead the in-house creative team: You are responsible for their development, their creative output, and the culture of the team. You set the quality bar and you hold it.
  • You also personally build. Depending on the week, that means designing a campaign asset, writing a brand narrative section, or art-directing a shoot.
  • Use AI as an operating principle to drive efficiencies and scale but not at the expense of producing lower quality outputs.
  • You drive the operating model for how creative work gets reviewed, who provides input at which stage, and where final approval sits. 
  • You own Agency and freelance relationships at strategy and execution level, managing iterative design development across multi-stakeholder projects and synthesizing internal feedback and direction
  • You define how we track brand health: distinctiveness, awareness, branded search trends, and influence.

    • Who You Are:

    You have defined and led a brand at a B2B company, ideally SaaS.  Your portfolio includes work you personally made, not only work you directed.

    You have run agency relationships, not just managed them. You know the difference between directing an agency and supervising one. 

    You are a credible partner to senior leadership. You can present brand rationale at board level, take input from the CEO

    You are AI-fluent in practice. You use AI tools in your creative workflow: for prototyping, for expanding what you can produce, for speed. You have formed clear opinions about when they add value and when they don't.

    The requirements:

  • 10 years of experience in brand strategy (in-house or agency) with at least 3 years owning brand direction at a company with a defined visual identity
  • Experience within a high-growth B2B or SaaS environment and a portfolio of B2B or enterprise brand work, including work you personally made
  • Comfortable diving into market data and research reports but possess the brand gut to know which insights actually matter
  • Can distill complex products and market dynamics into a clear, compelling narrative that inspires designers, writers, and executives alike
  • Know how to influence without authority and build strong partnerships with creative leads to drive the best possible work
  • Direct experience leading and developing in-house designers
  • A track record of managing creative agency relationships

At Pigment, we are rewriting the rules of business planning. To build the future of our own product, our internal Finance team must operate like a high-performing engineering squad. We don't just execute tasks; we architect systems.
 
As a Finance Engineer, you will sit at the crossroads of Accounting logic, Systems Architecture, and Generative AI. Reporting directly to the Head of FinOps, your mission is to treat the entire Finance stack as a machine: designing automated data pipelines, building production-ready apps via Pigment's Modeller Agents, and ensuring our financial infrastructure scales seamlessly as we grow. The position is Hybrid, meaning 3x per week from the office, no remote possibilities.

What Will You Do:

1. Systems Architecture & Modeling (50%)

  • Architect the Machine: Design, build, and optimize multidimensional models and process within Pigment for internal Accounting (P2P, QTC,R2R,..), Cash Management, and RevOps use cases.
  • Bridge the Gap: Translate complex accounting policies, billing structures, and revenue recognition rules into clean, scalable, logic-based data flows.
  • Tool-Agnostic Infrastructure: Ensure seamless data mapping between upstream systems (Zip, Navan, Salesforce) and our ERP ecosystem (Netsuite), maintaining a bulletproof "single source of truth."

    • 2. AI Engineering & Process Automation (30%)

  • Prompt Engineering & Agents: Leverage LLMs and Pigment’s native AI capabilities to build automated reporting agents.
  • Smart Automation: Deploy workflows (via Workflow automation tool : N8N or APIs,…) to automate month-end closing tasks, anomaly detection, and real-time cash forecasting.
  • Continuous Close: Actively scout and test next-generation Fintech tools to move the Finance department toward a fully automated, real-time audit-ready state.

    • 3. Governance, Support & Evolution (20%)

  • Code Mentality: Maintain clear technical documentation, schemas, and playbooks for our finance stack—treating financial logic with the same rigor as product code.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with the existing FP&A Modeler/Architect to maintain a unified data dictionary across the entire company.
  • Long-term Roadmap: Support the team's evolution as we prepare to fully internalize and optimize our ERP (NetSuite) architecture in early 2027.

    • Who You Are:
  • Experience: 3 to 6 years of experience in FinOps, RevOps, or as a Finance Business Analyst / Analytics Engineer within a fast-growing tech/SaaS company.
  • The "Builder" Mindset: High skills in multidimensional modeling (Pigment, PowerBi,…) or a strong background in data manipulation (Advanced SQL, Python, or expert-level logic).
    AI-Curious: You understand how to prompt LLMs, use APIs, and are excited about deploying AI agents to replace repetitive human processes.
  • Financial Fluency: You understand Accounting principles, P&L mechanics, and Cash flows. You can hold a deep conversation with our Finance team and translate their requirements into system logic.
  • Education: Degree in Engineering, Data Science, MIAGE, or Business School with a heavy focus on Business Intelligence / Information Systems.
  • Languages: French and English.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The opportunity
 
We are looking for an Engineering Program Manager (EPM) to help us scale our engineering team. Because we have EPMs almost since the beginning of Pigment, the role is already well-known. Our team is central to the engineering organization, perceived as a force multiplier by all the other engineers. We are constantly on the lookout to improve how we work. We like to try new ideas, whether it is to accelerate delivery, structure the organization or develop a unique culture. By joining our passionate, close-knitted team, you can have an impact in many different ways and learn in a team that is both young and fast-growing! 
Here is what the day-to-day of an EPM looks like at Pigment:
 
Deliver: You make a difference every day in the engineering team(s) you are working with, as you enhance clarity, direction, scope, and keep all the parts together with other roles (such as Product Managers). Typically an EPM accompanies 1 to 3 teams in their delivery, ranging from technical projects (e.g. scalability and performance, SRE) to more functional ones (e.g. bringing automations to our product).
 
Scale: You contribute to the engineering instances wherever you can bring added value. For instance, you can contribute to maintaining a healthy release pipeline, participate to incident response, oversee improvements to our monitoring and alerting practices…You also lead initiatives of various sizes to tackle the needs and issues that arise when growing as an organization. For instance, suggest evolutions to roles and responsibilities, better organize knowledge management, or work on large-scale projects related to quality management and production stability.
 
Federate: You contribute to the general well-being of the team, upon opportunity and based on affinity, for example as an organizer of regular instances (all-hands meetings, newsletters…), hackathons, team building activities, and any other idea related to the promotion of Pigment culture internally and externally. You also contribute to Pigment hiring and branding initiatives.
 
The team
As a team, we have a mission statement and a roadmap that we maintain over time. We are open to different styles and we rotate responsibilities and projects on a regular basis between us. We regularly exchange on our challenges in “co-development” sessions and sound new ideas to one another. You will also grow as an individual thanks to a career ladder and a culture of on-going feedback.
 
Explore Our Tech Blog:
If you're curious about the kind of challenges our engineering team tackles, our culture, and our organization, we invite you to explore our Tech Blog!
 
Who you are
 
We expect demonstrated experience in helping technical teams build and run in a fast-paced environment, with the right touch of processes and empowerment of individuals. 
 
Technical project/product management, engineering management, quality engineering, and production-related roles are typically the kind of roles where such an experience is demonstrated, but we are open to a diversity of backgrounds.
 
Experience as a software engineer is a plus but not required. The position does not involve coding. You should be able to read and understand code and read / comment / challenge a technical design.
 
To help you better understand the role, here are the qualities we are looking for in an EPM:
Resourcefulness: you like to be dropped in a new context and come up with your own solutions 
Change management: you are a people person and you convey change smartly and courageously
Diligence: you are curious and connect the dots in ways no one else can, you strive to reach alignment through shared understanding, clarity, and direction
Integrity: you lead by example, inspire others, and always play “first team”
 
The position doesn’t involve people management.
Fluency in English (French not required)
 
Folks from underrepresented minorities: science shows that you are less likely to apply if you feel that you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites. If this description matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply.

The Customer Marketing Manager is a storyteller and relationship-builder, at the heart of Pigment's Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Community & Customer Marketing. You will turn real customer outcomes into the case studies, speakers, and proof points that celebrate what our customers have achieved with Pigment, working closely with our Customer Community efforts to bring those relationships to life — built on genuine partnership and mutual trust, never on transactional asks.

What You will do:
This is an individual-contributor role at the center of a small, fast-moving team — high in ownership and cross-functional influence.
 
  • Customer Storytelling & Evidence: Partner with Pigment's customers and internal teams to identify, create, guide through approvals, and share high-fidelity case studies, testimonials, and video stories — a core way we celebrate and showcase our customers' success across Sales and Marketing.

  • Flagship Partnerships: Nurture relationships with strategically important customers, building the trust and internal alignment it takes to earn the honor of telling their story publicly

  • Public Speaking Alignment: Identify and invite customer speakers for events and webinars, matching the right customer voice to the right stage

  • External Visibility: Connect enthusiastic customers with opportunities for PR and social amplification, analyst surveys, and peer review sites (e.g. G2) — and, where relevant, help cultivate Pigment's presence within extended communities (finance professionals, AI/data practitioners) beyond our customer base, surfacing new stories and voices along the way

  • Systems of Record: Keep a thoughtful, living record of who we've worked with and how — so customers aren't over-approached twice for the same ask, and every relationship is handled with the care and memory it deserves — including managing the internal AI tools that help surface the right customer story to our sales teams just when they need it most

  • Metrics & Reporting: Support customer marketing metrics and reporting, translating story output into a clear read on reach and impact for internal stakeholders

  • Customer Recognition: Make sure every customer who shares their story is properly thanked and celebrated — through visibility for their own brand and team, invitations to exclusive Pigment moments, and public recognition that reflects genuinely well on them

  • Sales Reference Ownership**: Help drive the sales reference process — fulfilling requests thoughtfully, keeping Salesforce and other tools running smoothly for self-service, and making sure every customer who says yes is matched to the right opportunity, recognized for their time, and not over-asked


    • Who You Are:

  • Experience in customer marketing, case studies, or advocacy content within B2B tech — or comparable storytelling experience in PR, comms, or content marketing — with a track record of turning genuine relationships into public celebrations of success

  • Incredible relationship skills — a natural connector of people and details, equally comfortable in a CSM's inbox, a VP's calendar, and a customer's legal/comms review

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the judgment to hold a conversation at any level, from end users to C-suite

  • Tool-savvy and genuinely interested in scaling your own workflow with AI-assisted tools (Claude, Notion, Deeto, Salesforce, and similar)

  • Patient and strategic — able to nurture a meaningful relationship with an important customer over time, and know when to pause and protect that relationship above all else

  • A focused storyteller with a strong point of view on what makes a story land, and the discipline to prioritize the few stories that matter most

  • A great team member who brings energy to a small, fast-moving function and treats every customer interaction as a chance to build trust and celebrate what they've accomplished

Flag when it's time to nurture new advocates.

    • Partner with Customer Community: You'll sit alongside the Community team, so customer stories and community moments naturally reinforce each other, giving customers more ways to connect with Pigment and with each other.

    • Partner with Corporate Comms, PR & Analyst Relations: Nurture a community of customers ready for media moments, analyst surveys, and peer review campaigns, so we're never relying on a single personal contact

    • Partner with Product: Feed customer story themes and roadmap-relevant feedback back to Product, and cultivate advocate relationships aligned to where the roadmap is heading

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Aircraft Painter to join our aviation maintenance team. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing and painting aircraft surfaces to meet high industry standards. As an Aircraft Painter, you will work on a variety of aircraft types, ensuring the external appearance and protective coating of the aircraft meet both aesthetic and regulatory standards. Your expertise in surface preparation, painting, and finishing will be crucial in ensuring aircraft are ready for operation and maintain their durability in various conditions.

This role is essential for ensuring that aircraft are protected from environmental elements and have a visually appealing and professional finish. If you have an eye for detail and a passion for precision work, this is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the aviation industry.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Prepare aircraft surfaces for painting by cleaning, masking, and sanding areas to remove old paint or contaminants.
  • Apply primers, base coats, and topcoats according to industry standards and manufacturer specifications.
  • Use spray painting equipment to ensure even and accurate application of paint to aircraft surfaces.
  • Follow precise instructions and blueprints to create custom designs, logos, or lettering on aircraft.
  • Inspect painted surfaces for quality, ensuring proper thickness, gloss, and uniformity of color.
  • Repair and touch up paintwork as necessary, ensuring aircraft meet regulatory and aesthetic standards.
  • Maintain and clean painting equipment and tools, ensuring they are in proper working order.
  • Comply with safety regulations, using appropriate protective gear and ensuring the workspace is safe and clean.
  • Record and document all work performed, including materials used and procedures followed.
  • Work with other maintenance team members to ensure the aircraft is ready for delivery on schedule.
  • Ensure compliance with environmental regulations regarding the use of chemicals and hazardous materials.
  • Assist in the development of painting schedules and timelines, ensuring that projects are completed on time.

    • Qualifications:
  • Proven experience as an Aircraft Painter or in a related role (e.g., automotive or industrial painting).
  • Familiarity with aircraft painting techniques, materials, and procedures.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and specifications.
  • Skilled in the use of spray guns, sanders, buffers, and other painting equipment.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce high-quality finishes.
  • Knowledge of safety protocols related to handling hazardous chemicals and materials.
  • Physical stamina and dexterity to work in confined spaces or at heights.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and collaborate effectively with other technicians and engineers.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills.

    • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working with a variety of aircraft types (commercial, military, private jets, etc.).
  • Familiarity with corrosion prevention and metal treatment processes.
  • Knowledge of environmentally safe painting products and techniques.
  • Ability to apply complex custom designs, logos, or branding.
  • Certification in aircraft painting or a relevant field (preferred but not mandatory depending on experience).
  • Knowledge of relevant aviation regulatory standards (such as FAA or EASA guidelines) concerning painting and surface finishing.
  • Training in the safe handling of hazardous materials (e.g., OSHA, WHMIS certification).

Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus was founded by Simon Porte Jacquemus in 2009 in Paris, France.

Dedicated to the memory of the designer’s late mother, the brand draws inspiration from a passion for culture. The Jacquemus ready-to-wear and accessories collections for men and women reference the French way of life and universal gestures of beauty, encompassing influences from fine art photography to decorative arts, cinema, painting, and sculpture.

Throughout the years, Jacquemus has staged runway productions in unique and unexpected locations, including a Parisian swimming pool, the Musée Picasso, a lavender field in Provence, a wheat field outside Paris, a salt marsh in the Camargue, and a beach in Hawaii. More recently, the brand has embraced settings such as the canal of the Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), the Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), Casa Malaparte (La Casa) and Auguste Perret’s Parisian apartment (La Croisière).

Based in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, Jacquemus is an independent fashion house with over 300 employees. Renowned for its fast-growing digital presence and its worldwide business spread, the brand has created innovative retail experiences around the world before opening its first permanent flagship store at 58 Avenue Montaigne in Paris in 2022. Following this milestone, international boutiques have opened in New York (SoHo), London (New Bond Street), Los Angeles (Melrose Avenue) and Dubai.

YOUR ROLE 

Within the Jacquemus Knitwear Design team, you will work across both Womenswear and Menswear collections.

Working closely with the Head of Knitwear Design, you will contribute to the creative development of the collections, from initial research and concept through to fittings and final product.

MISSIONS

- Creative research and development of knitwear concepts, silhouettes, shapes and details ; 

- Design across both Womenswear and Menswear ; 

- Research and development of yarns, stitches, techniques and finishings ; 

- Development of innovative and experimental knitwear, including mixed techniques and materials ; 

- Creation and update of technical files for each design ; 

- Preparation and follow-up of designs with development team ; 

-  Participation in fittings and follow-up of prototypes through to final validation ; 

- Support of the team throughout the different stages of the collection.

YOUR PROFILE

- You have a strong experience in knitwear design within a fashion luxury house ; 

- You have a strong fashion sensibility and excellent understanding of knitwear construction and techniques ; 

- You are creative, curious and hands-on, you should be comfortable developing both stronf runway pieces and more product-driven designs, with the ability to translate creative ideas into clear product respecting the brand DNA. 

This position is based in the 8th arrondissement of Paris.

Diabolocom is looking for a Technical Project Manager to coordinate engineering delivery across our organization and work closely with the Head of Software Engineering on roadmap execution.

You will work across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to keep delivery on track, manage dependencies, identify risks early, and help turn delivery challenges into clear actions and decisions.

We are looking for someone with a software engineering background who has moved into technical leadership and genuinely enjoys the operational side of engineering.

The role

Our engineering organization includes around 90 engineers across 12 teams, working on a complex global product and multiple parallel initiatives.

This role combines ownership of our engineering delivery processes with hands-on execution. You will be responsible not only for running these processes, but also for continuously improving how we plan, coordinate and track delivery across the organization.

Process ownership

You will own and continuously improve:

  • engineering delivery planning processes
  • delivery tracking and reporting
  • cross-team coordination and dependency management.

You will build on our existing practices and ClickUp workflows, identifying what can work better and evolving the processes as the organization and product develop.

Delivery execution

Day to day, you will:

  • track delivery across teams and releases
  • coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across teams
  • identify risks, blockers and delivery gaps early
  • challenge unclear timelines, priorities and commitments
  • coordinate next steps when delivery is at risk
  • provide clear visibility on delivery status and progress.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to facilitate alignment.

The objective is simple: make software delivery predictable, transparent and effective.

What success looks like

First few weeks: You start taking ownership of delivery operations and become effective in coordinating ongoing delivery.

Within ~6-8 weeks: You understand the roadmap, teams, dependencies and delivery processes well enough to manage them confidently and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

Within 3 months: You operate autonomously across day-to-day engineering delivery coordination, bringing in the Head of Software Engineering when decisions or trade-offs require escalation.

Your work will directly influence our delivery efficiency and predictability: how much we can take on and how reliably we deliver what we commit to.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone who started in software engineering and moved into technical leadership, for example, an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, senior Team Lead, or Technical Program Manager.

Titles matter less than scope. You need enough technical depth to understand architecture and dependencies, ask the right questions, and navigate complex delivery problems across teams.

We expect

  • around 10 years of experience in software engineering environments
  • at least 3 years in engineering or technical leadership
  • previous hands-on experience as a software engineer
  • experience leading or coordinating multiple engineering teams
  • a track record of delivering complex software initiatives and improving execution
  • strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, distributed systems and cross-team dependencies
  • understanding of Product Management fundamentals
  • experience with Agile and structured project management frameworks such as PMBOK or similar
  • strong prioritization, decision-making and communication skills
  • professional fluency in English.

French and Russian are nice to have.

This role will suit you if…

You still enjoy technical complexity, but what really motivates you is making execution work.

You like finding out why something is stuck and fixing it.

You genuinely enjoy the operational side of engineering: creating structure, improving processes, coordinating teams and making sure things get delivered.

You don’t just want to follow an established process. You naturally look for ways to make it work better.

You are comfortable working across multiple teams, asking difficult questions when needed, and bringing structure to situations where priorities, dependencies or timelines are not immediately clear.

Why Diabolocom

Diabolocom is building one of Europe’s most advanced AI-native CCaaS platforms, powering business-critical customer interactions for 400+ enterprise and mid-market customers across 60+ countries.

We combine a mature global CCaaS platform with a rapidly growing AI Product Suite, backed by our internal AI Research Lab and proprietary AI innovation.

Our ambition goes beyond adding AI features to an existing product. We are building toward a platform capable of orchestrating AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels, with CCaaS as the execution layer.

For Engineering, this means working on the technical and operational challenges of an established enterprise product, from real-time communications and distributed systems to complex integrations, while contributing to its next generation.

With teams across Europe, the US, Brazil and the UAE, and an engineering organization of around 90 people, this role offers the opportunity to work on engineering delivery behind a global product used for critical customer operations.

Why this role

This is a hands-on role combining delivery execution with process ownership.

You will work with the Head of Software Engineering, Team Leads, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams, with a broad view of engineering delivery across the organization.

You will inherit established delivery practices, own them, and continuously improve how we plan, coordinate and track execution.

Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth.

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

  • Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.
  • On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.
  • Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.
  • Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.
  • Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.
  • AI infrastructure — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities.
  • Storage system — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure.

This is infrastructure engineering where reliability, latency, scalability, and operational excellence directly impact the product.

You will not simply maintain existing systems. You will help shape the architecture, processes, and team structure required for the next stage of our growth — taking ownership of critical infrastructure decisions from the ground up.

Your mission

Your goal is to make infrastructure ready for the next stage of scaling up by building a strong operational foundation across all the infrastructure domains.

You will:

  • Own infrastructure reliability and operations across the whole stack: incident management, monitoring, alerting, post-mortems and prevention of recurring failures.
  • Improve operational visibility across infrastructure teams: identify bottlenecks, improve processes and drive continuous improvements.
  • Improve capacity planning processes, connecting business growth and infrastructure needs.
  • Lead the evolution of our network and telecom infrastructure: topology, connectivity, carrier relationships, routing, redundancy and voice platform performance and reliability.
  • Own our on-premise infrastructure operations: data centers, hardware, storage, connectivity and deployment practices.
  • Drive scalability and reliability of our stateful infrastructure: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis and other critical systems.
  • Support the evolution of our AI infrastructure, including GPU workloads and compute clusters.
  • Drive infrastructure improvements with automation, observability and tooling.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure applications run reliably on our platforms.
  • Lead and grow the Infrastructure team across Networking, SRE, Stateful Systems, Voice, and Data Center squads.

Who we are looking for

We are not looking for someone who has mastered every infrastructure domain.

We are looking for a strong infrastructure engineer and leader who has built complex systems, understands operational excellence and wants broader ownership.

You might be:

  • a Head of Infrastructure looking for a more hands-on technical challenge;
  • an Infrastructure Manager who still enjoys engineering;
  • a Staff/Principal SRE who has been leading infrastructure beyond their formal title;
  • a network or systems engineer who grew into technical leadership.

Must Have

  • Deep expertise in at least 2–3 infrastructure domains, such as:
    • networking;
    • SRE/reliability;
    • database administration;
    • telecom/voice infrastructure;
    • hardware/on-premise infrastructure.
  • Proven experience building and improving infrastructure operations: establishing processes, improving reliability practices, driving incident management and creating effective ways of working across multiple infrastructure domains.
  • Experience leading technical teams where different groups own different areas of infrastructure (for example networking, SRE, databases, systems or platform engineering).
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you stay close to technology, understand technical details and lead through context and expertise.
  • Self-taught, hands-on background — you have grown technically by solving complex problems beyond your formal role.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work onsite in Paris.

Nice to Have

Experience with:

  • Telecom or carrier infrastructure.
  • Voice platforms or real-time communication systems.
  • PostgreSQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ or Redis operational experience at scale.
  • Dark fiber, peering and advanced networking.
  • Kubernetes in production.
  • GPU infrastructure.
  • Incident command and post-mortem culture.

About You

You are motivated by complexity and ownership, not titles.

You solve problems before being asked.

You are comfortable with ambiguity — infrastructure is complex, and you know how to make pragmatic technical trade-offs.

You enjoy building teams and scaling impact through people, not only systems.

You stay curious about networking, hardware trends, observability and modern infrastructure practices.

Why join us

Own infrastructure decisions with real business impact.

Your work will directly influence reliability, customer experience and engineering velocity.

Work on infrastructure that cannot simply be outsourced.

From telecom networks and hardware to distributed systems and AI workloads, you will solve problems where architecture and engineering decisions matter.

Build something from an early stage of maturity.

You will help establish the operational discipline, processes and team structure needed for the next phase of growth.

Work directly with technical leadership.

You will report directly to Sergey, our CTO, who is deeply involved in infrastructure and technical decisions while giving infrastructure leaders the ownership to drive changes.

Recruitment Process

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition
    Up to 1h — alignment on experience, expectations and motivation.

  2. Two technical conversations with Sergey, CTO
    Focused on:

  • infrastructure strategy;
  • technical depth;

  1. Meeting with the infrastructure team

The strongest candidates are often engineers who grew into leadership by taking ownership, solving complex problems and going beyond their formal responsibilities.

Une nouvelle vision pour la billetterie, au service du monde de la culture, du live et des loisirs
 
Bienvenue chez vivenu, leader mondial de la billetterie événementielle et l'une des entreprises technologiques à la croissance la plus rapide au monde. Nous avons révolutionné la billetterie de sites et producteurs comme les Grammy Awards, les Golden Globes, la Fondation Cartier, la Fondation Louis Vuitton ou Culturespaces transformant les process de billetterie et les données collectées lors des parcours de vente en avantage stratégique. Bénéficiant d’investissements à hauteur de 65 millions de dollars vivenu permet aux organisateurs d'événements de mettre en avant leur identité, de transformer l’expérience client, et d'intégrer la billetterie de manière transparente dans leur écosystème numérique.
 
vivenu s’engage auprès de ses partenaires pour assurer un support d’excellence et pour répondre de façon simple à leurs enjeux en créant des expériences exceptionnelles.
 
Rejoignez-nous et participez à la transformation des métiers de la billetterie et du marketing.

En tant que Customer Success Manager, vos responsabilités comprendront :
  • Maîtrise technique et alignement stratégique : gérer proactivement votre portefeuille clients en devenant l’expert produit de référence. Développer des plans d’actions qui traduisent les objectifs de vos clients en configurations techniques de la plateforme vivenu.
  • Implémentation et architecture applicative : piloter l’intégration technique de vos partenaires. Analyser les workflows existants pour concevoir des solutions sur mesure au sein de l’écosystème vivenu, garantissant un déploiement efficace et scalable.
  • Expertise produit et innovation : agir en tant que consultant technologique pour renforcer les partenariats avec vos clients lors d’ateliers techniques. Mobiliser vos clients autour d’initiatives comme le Lab vivenu pour coconcevoir et tester de nouvelles briques technologiques.
  • Optimisation opérationnelle : conseiller vos clients sur l’utilisation avancée des fonctionnalités de vivenu pour maximiser l’expérience utilisateur et stimuler les revenus grâce à l’utilisation des données et automatiser les processus opérationnels complexes.
  • Analyse de données et santé technique : monitorer les indicateurs de performance (KPIs) et les logs d’utilisation pour identifier les blocages techniques ou les sous-utilisations, et déployer des correctifs concrets.
  • Croissance et expansion technologique : identifier les opportunités d’extension de contrats en démontrant la valeur ajoutée de nouveaux modules fonctionnels ou d’intégrations API supplémentaires.
  •  Interface produit / ingénierie : assurer l’interface entre vos clients et les équipes produit et techniques. Traduire les retours clients en spécifications techniques détaillées pour influencer directement la feuille de route logicielle de vivenu.
  • Expertise et transfert de compétences : assurer une veille constante sur les évolutions techniques de la plateforme. Concevoir et dispenser des formations techniques de haut niveau pour garantir l’adoption des fonctionnalités les plus pointues pour répondre et dépasser les objectifs de vos clients.

    • Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir dans ce rôle :
  • Gestion des relations avec vos interlocuteurs : capacité avérée à établir et à maintenir des relations solides avec un large éventail d’interlocuteurs – y compris les responsables de la billetterie, les équipes numériques et informatiques et la direction.
  • Gestion de portefeuille et priorisation : expérience dans la gestion d'un portefeuille de clients, avec la capacité de gérer efficacement le temps et les ressources en fonction des besoins, des objectifs et des indicateurs de performance de vos clients.
  • Planification stratégique : compétences dans la création de plans stratégiques fondés sur la connaissance client, les informations du CRM, les données d'utilisation en temps réel et les tendances pertinentes du marché.
  • Communication efficace sous différents formats : aisance dans l'animation d'ateliers, la présentation produits et la conduite de revues d'affaires au niveau exécutif – avec un message adapté à chaque public.
  • Engagement sur le produit : une approche technique rigoureuse et la volonté de vous engager directement dans la configuration de la plateforme pour répondre au mieux aux enjeux et objectifs de vos clients.
  • Aisance technique : une capacité à expliquer clairement les concepts techniques – tels que les fonctionnalités liées à la sécurité, les API et les intégrations monétiques – d'une manière accessible à vos interlocuteurs qu’ils aient des profils techniques ou non.
  • Résolution proactive de problèmes : un état d'esprit orienté vers la recherche de solutions, en particulier lors de l’analyse de points complexes et de défis techniques.
  • Gestion de projet : compréhension approfondie de la méthodologie de suivi de projets et d’engagement, y compris la réation de valeur et les stratégies d’engagement à long terme.
  • Expérience professionnelle : 3+ années d'expérience dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : customer success ou chef de projet pour un service logiciel — en général et dans le secteur de la billetterie en particulier.
  • Français & Anglais courants (niveau C1/C2) requis afin d’assurer une communication fluide et professionnelle avec nos clients et partenaires francophones.
    • Pourquoi rejoindre vivenu ?
     
    Pour être au cœur de l’exploitation de clients de renommée mondiale, en redéfinissant l’expérience utilisateur, grâce à une technologie de rupture.
     
    Une croissance durable
    Nous nous développons durablement en mettant l’accent sur la rentabilité et sommes soutenus par des fonds d’investissement de premier plan. Cela signifie un investissement continu dans nos employés, nos produits et notre vision à long terme.
     
    Une équipe engagée et mue par l’excellence
    Collaborez avec plus de 130 professionnels dévoués, comprenant des leaders venant de Google, Slack et Salesforce. Ensemble, nous façonnons l'avenir des technologies au service de la culture, des événements et des loisirs.
     
    Une emprise globale
    Nous sommes une équipe riche de sa diversité, axée sur le mérite — et répartie dans six bureaux dans le monde. Le talent et l'impact sont ce qui compte avant tout chez vivenu.
     
    Une croissance rapide
    Sifted classe vivenu parmi les scale-ups à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous sommes nourris par la volonté d’apprendre au quotidien et de nous améliorer continuement.
     
    Développer notre position de leaders et contribuer directement à la transformation de notre industrie
    Travaillez aux côtés de visionnaires — des fondateurs de Forbes 30 Under 30, aux lauréats du prix Executive of the Year. Chez vivenu, vous contribuerez à établir les nouvelles normes de l'industrie de la billetterie.
     
    Consultez la mission et les valeurs d'entreprise de vivenu ici.
     
    Chez vivenu, nous croyons que nos employés sont la clé de notre succès – et que l’esprit audacieux et la diversité de nos collaborateurs sont une richesse. Nous nous engageons à créer un cadre de travail qui offre à chaque collaborateur la possibilité de contribuer au succès de tous et de s'épanouir.

About JSSI
Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Chicago, Jet Support Services, Inc. (JSSI) is the largest independent provider of hourly cost maintenance programs for business aviation. JSSI delivers comprehensive coverage for engines, airframes, and auxiliary power units (APUs) across more than 300 different aircraft makes and models, helping owners and operators stabilize maintenance budgets, maximize aircraft availability, and protect asset value throughout the lifecycle of ownership.   JSSI has built a portfolio of complementary business lines designed to simplify the economic and technical complexity of business aviation; these include Maintenance teams, Traxxall maintenance tracking software, Parts & Engines, Conklin aircraft cost and performance data, and Aviation Capital asset-based financing solutions. Together, these offerings support owners, operators, and maintenance providers with integrated tools spanning ownership and maintenance planning, execution, and financial management.   With more than 6,500 aircraft supported through programs and software platforms, JSSI leverages its unique independence, unmatched scale, and data-driven insight to deliver customized solutions and support models aligned to the interests of each client — regardless of aircraft platform. JSSI is backed by leading institutional investors GTCR, Genstar Capital, and Blackstone. Learn more at jetsupport.com. 

Position Summary

The Technical Advisor serves as the primary point of contact between the Client and the maintenance organization for both airframe and engine matters, acting as a trusted technical representative throughout the lifecycle of aircraft maintenance events. This role manages and coordinates client needs across routine maintenance, minor unscheduled findings, major scheduled inspections, and Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations — for airframes, engines, and related systems — utilizing Product Line Specialists (PLS) as needed to support events requiring specialized assistance.

As the customer's key technical liaison, the Technical Advisor acts as an advocate for the Client and provides expert guidance to support informed decision-making, balancing airworthiness, operational impact, cost control, and schedule adherence.


Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with customers to evaluate and recommend the most appropriate inspection and maintenance alternatives for airframe and engine events.
  • Set up and support customers in coordinating all aspects of maintenance events — including preliminary scheduled inspections, minor unscheduled findings, and major unscheduled or major scheduled events — with assigned repair facilities and service providers.
  • Provide on-site customer representation, particularly during major scheduled inspections.
  • Support customers during Aircraft on Ground (AOG) events, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
  • Create and manage Service Calls to track technical data, event progress, and support financial forecasting.
  • Develop and maintain strong client relationships through regular and proactive communication.
  • Build and sustain working relationships with regional service facilities, mobile repair teams, and other service providers.
  • Research aircraft logbooks and/or perform visual inspections for new enrollments or existing contract reviews.
  • Review and process invoices in AMS, meeting turn-time goals established by Technical Services Management and company policy.
  • Perform event triage by assessing maintenance findings and ensuring each situation is handled appropriately and efficiently, serving as primary liaison between maintenance facilities, parts sourcing vendors, and the customer — handling the event directly or turning it over to a Product Line Specialist as needed.
  • Conduct asset inspections when enrolling new aircraft into service programs.
  • Maintain a thorough working knowledge of applicable contracts, policies, and procedures.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by Technical Services Management.

    • Desired Credentials:
  • Unrestricted work and residency authorization in the United States required.
  • Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) ratings, or equivalent, required.
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in an Aviation field preferred.
  • 10 years' experience with corporate turbine-powered business aircraft (not commercial) preferred, with particular expertise working with Gulfstream and Bombardier airframes and their associated engine platforms.
  • Excellent Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to read and write articulately and analytically.
  • Clear understanding of relevant technical skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work well under pressure.
  • Well organized.
  • Have or be able to obtain a passport and perform international travel.
    • At JSSI, we are committed to rewarding our team members with competitive and comprehensive compensation packages that reflect their contributions and talent.
     
    For this role, the annual base pay generally ranges from $90,000 to $105,000, with the final offer determined by variable factors including but not limited to market location, job-specific knowledge, skills, education, and experience. In addition, your total rewards package may include an annual discretionary bonus plan, incentive or sales bonus plan, or other form of additional compensation, based on your role.
     
    Additionally, for full-time employees based in the USA, Canada, or the Philippines, we are proud to offer a robust suite of benefits. This ranges from insurance offerings such as medical, dental, vision, retirement savings programs, among others, starting day one of employment. For a full overview of our offerings, visit the JSSI Benefits Page on our company website.

    JSSI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristic protected by law.

    JSSI does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team.

Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d’utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs professionnels dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde. L’entreprise propose des solutions complètes de bout en bout pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur taille. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs couvrant la protection anti-intrusion, la vidéosurveillance, la sécurité incendie et la protection des personnes, ainsi que le confort et l’automatisation. Ajax Systems emploie aujourd’hui plus de 5 000 collaborateurs.
 
Nous développons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts sur le terrain sont les mieux placés pour comprendre les spécificités de chaque marché. L’entreprise dispose de représentants commerciaux dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, Espagne, Allemagne, France, Royaume-Uni, États-Unis, Australie, Afrique du Sud, ainsi que dans de nombreuses autres régions. L’équipe Global Business Development est composée de profils partageant les ambitions élevées et la vision de croissance d’Ajax Systems.
 
La combinaison du meilleur logiciel et d’un matériel puissant a durablement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur. Récompensée lors des plus grands salons spécialisés tels que IFSEC, Expoprotection et Intersec, et lauréate de prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence comme PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax Systems est aujourd’hui l’un des fabricants de systèmes de sécurité les plus primés en Europe.
La production d’Ajax Systems repose sur quatre sites industriels : deux en Ukraine, un en Turquie et un au Vietnam. Par ailleurs, la certification de l’entreprise selon la norme ISO 14001 garantit un impact environnemental minimal de ses activités de production. La sélection des composants utilisés dans la fabrication des dispositifs Ajax repose sur des déclarations des fournisseurs confirmant leur conformité aux exigences RoHS.
 
L’entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre. C’est pourquoi la résilience est au cœur de l’ADN de la marque. Lutter contre le mal en créant les meilleures solutions de sécurité et d’automatisation constitue la mission constante et inébranlable d’Ajax Systems.

Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation.  The company employs 5, 000 specialists. 

We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems. 

The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe.

Ajax Systems production includes four factories, two of which are located in Ukraine, one in Turkey and one in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission.
