At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role:

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer based in our Paris office to lead the technical transformations that are too large, too cross-cutting, or too critical to belong to a single engineering team.

This is a company-wide IC role with direct report to the CTO and explicit authority to drive major technical decisions across Product Engineering, Platform, Infrastructure and Data.

This isn't an advisory role, it's a mandate to change how Brevo Engineering works at a foundational level


What you will do:

You will own a small number of high-impact technical transformations end to end: architecture, implementation strategy, migration, adoption and retirement of legacy systems.

Examples include:

  • rebuilding our CI/CD and deployment architecture across hundreds of services and repositories;
  • replacing fragmented logging and observability patterns with an OpenTelemetry-based platform backed by ClickHouse;
  • redesigning how we use Kafka and introducing stronger platform abstractions around messaging;
  • turning ClickHouse into a first-class internal product rather than a database consumed inconsistently across teams;
  • defining and driving common standards around service communication, reliability, runtime architecture and developer platforms.

    • These initiatives will cross organizational boundaries and require changes to both infrastructure and application code.

    Your responsibility is to own the projects end to end, driving them through every stage and resolving whatever obstacles arise until it is delivered.


    Who you are:
  • You have already operated at Principal, Distinguished, Senior Principal, Fellow, or equivalent level within a significantly larger engineering organization.
  • You have repeatedly led transformations involving
  • hundreds of engineers or large service fleets,
  • distributed systems and production infrastructure,
  • complex migrations where old and new worlds had to coexist,
  • strong technical disagreement across senior teams,
  • and architecture decisions with broad and lasting consequences.
  • You move fluidly between a system design discussion, a code review, a production incident, a migration plan, and an executive-level technical decision.
  • You bring deep expertise in several of the following: Kubernetes, CI/CD, Kafka, ClickHouse, OpenTelemetry, distributed databases, service communication, developer platforms, and large-scale observability.
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

Location and travel

You can be based in Europe; we're mainly remote and invite you to the Berlin office 3-5 days every two months.

We expect significant travel across the Europe, with occasional travel to other regions when the audience quality justifies it. The exact cadence will change with the event calendar, but you should expect travel to be a meaningful part of the job.

 

Why this role?

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks.

We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum.

The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable.

 

What you'll do

  • Represent Langfuse at conferences, meetups, workshops, customer events, partner events, and community gatherings across Europe

  • Run live demos and technical sessions on tracing, evals, prompt management, datasets, metrics, and related LLM engineering workflows.

  • Build and maintain field-ready material: demo flows, workshop runbooks, talk abstracts, event landing pages, follow-up emails, signup flows, and conference-in-a-box assets.

  • Organize Langfuse-hosted meetups, workshops, dinners, and smaller technical gatherings around the highest-quality audiences.

  • Partner with ClickHouse field marketing, sales, solutions, product marketing, and engineering teams where it helps Langfuse show up well.

  • Turn event learnings into useful artifacts: better messaging, better demos, better docs, better talks, better customer stories, and sharper product feedback.

 

What we're looking for

  • You have worked in DevRel, product marketing engineering, solutions engineering, field engineering, developer advocacy, or technical community roles.

  • You have spoken at developer conferences, meetups, workshops, webinars, or technical customer events.

  • You already create technical content, demos, videos, talks, open source projects, or educational material.

  • You should be excited to travel, give talks, run demos, host events, talk to developers and technical leaders, and bring what you learn back into the company.

A strong plus:

data.description:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the team, culture and processes that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when a strong product turns into a real business: how do we build the strategy, the partner and customer pipeline, and the operating rhythm that let us scale as fast as the technology allows?

The Role

As a Working Student or thesis student in Strategy Operations & Business Development, you will work directly with our Business Development lead and on the questions that decide how TACTILIA grows: which markets we go after, how we price and cost what we build, who our first partners and customers are, and how we prove our progress to the board.

Some days you're sizing a market or building a competitor teardown. Other days you're pulling together the numbers for a board update or helping shape a pricing model. Both matter equally here.

What You Will Do

– Support business strategy and market sizing. Help translate our target markets and product priorities into clear numbers – market size, growth, and where the real opportunity sits.

– Track the competitive landscape. Keep tabs on competitors, adjacent players, and relevant funding and product news, and turn it into insights the leadership team can actually use.

– Help build our partner and customer pipeline. Research and qualify potential integrators, partners, and anchor customers, and prepare the materials that support outreach and first conversations.

– Get our office and internal structures off the ground. Help plan and implement our office set-up and the practical structures a growing team needs on the ground – this is a hands-on part of the role, not just an analytical one.

– Help build our internal reporting and steering tools. Contribute to the dashboards and processes that give the leadership team a real-time view of the business.

What You Bring

– Currently studying business administration, industrial engineering, economics, or a related field (Bachelor's or Master's)

– A structured, analytical way of working and genuine comfort with numbers and data

– Real interest in robotics, deep tech, or Physical AI

– Confident with Excel and PowerPoint, and quick to pick up new tools

– Fluent English; German is a plus

– Available for at least four to six months, whether as a working student or for a thesis project

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.

That means your decisions will have a lasting impact – not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

We're looking for people with software engineering backgrounds who are ready to move into technical project management, owning the business systems work behind our transition from a legacy stack to a new one. These are growth paths, not fully-formed PM seats.

Our legacy stack involves over 100 systems across the globe including proprietary invoicing/billing/scheduling systems, two Salesforce instances and NetSuite, among others. Our new stack is HubSpot, Metronome, Stripe, NetSuite, and Workato. Getting from one to the other — while the business keeps running on both — is the core challenge of both tracks.

We're hiring two people into this role. The skills profile is similar for both, but each hire will own one of two distinct tracks: O2C Integrations or CRM Projects. These tracks will eventually mature into a larger scope of internal tooling and enterprise customization. Track assignment will be based on candidate strengths and interest during onboarding, rather than decided in advance.

Track 1: Order-to-Cash Integrations Projects

Focused on building and connecting

  • Own the Order-to-Cash flow end-to-end — Across both tech stacks. You're accountable for how orders, invoicing, billing, and revenue data move through the business, regardless of which systems they touch.

  • Set integration ecosystem strategy — Define how integrations across business systems should be architected as a whole: point-to-point vs. centralized (e.g., via Workato), reusable patterns, and standards for how new systems connect in.

  • Co-build the Legacy system replacement s— Partner with the Enterprise product team as technical owner of how the new platform's O2C integration layer is architected, including data models and API contracts.

  • Control integration vendors — Own technical evaluation, SLAs, and build-vs-buy decisions for integration tooling and vendors across the ecosystem.

  • Bridge legacy and new-stack engineering teams — Be the technical point of contact ensuring O2C data contracts and dependencies are understood on both sides.

Track 2: CRM & Martech Projects

Focused on retiring and migrating CRM systems

  • Lead the Salesforce 2A sunset project — Own the plan, timeline, and execution for retiring this legacy Salesforce instance, coordinating data migration and cutover with dependent teams.

  • Lead the Salesforce STAR sunset project — Same ownership model, applied to the STAR instance.

  • Control the HubSpot vendor relationship — Own vendor management for HubSpot, including contract terms, SLA performance, and roadmap alignment with vendor capabilities.

  • Own marketing automations — Own the roadmap and execution for marketing automation workflows (built largely on HubSpot). Campaign strategy sits with Marketing; you own the tooling and execution layer those campaigns run on.

  • Manage sunset risk — Identify what breaks if a legacy system goes away too early, and build technically sound mitigation and rollback plans.

What We're Looking For

  • Software engineering background — you've built, maintained, or integrated production systems, ideally including APIs, middleware, or data pipelines.

  • Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders alike.

  • Detail oriented and structured approach — planning and running complex, multi-stakeholder technical projects to completion, including sequencing, risk management, and timeline ownership.

  • Comfortable reading and reasoning about system architecture and data models across multiple connected systems without translation from engineering.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, especially around evolving scope boundaries between adjacent teams during a platform migration.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with billing/invoicing/CRM systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, HubSpot, Stripe, Metronome, Workato, or similar).

  • Experience with vendor management, including contract and SLA negotiation.

  • Background in a company undergoing a legacy-to-modern platform migration.

  • Experience defining integration strategy or standards at an organizational level, not just shipping individual integrations; exposure to integration architecture patterns (point-to-point, iPaaS/middleware, event-driven).

  • Formal project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar) — helpful but not required with structured ways of working

Why You Should Join

This is a rare, explicitly structured path out of pure engineering — you're hired as an engineer, judged on engineering judgment, and grow into project management on the job. You'll get unusually broad system exposure fast, which is the kind of company-wide operational map most engineers wait years to see. You will be joining a project management and product operations team and receive ongoing coaching for your career development.

Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Platform team in an internal-facing role focused on delivery excellence. You'll be the connective tissue across product teams — enabling fast, informed decision-making, keeping engineering delivery on track day-to-day, making sure our platform holds up to country-specific regulatory requirements as we scale globally and defining requirements for the platform back office.

Alongside the day-to-day delivery work, you'll run a set of platform-wide programs: centralizing consent management and interfacing with the GTM team. This role is less about owning a single customer-facing roadmap and more about being the operational and program backbone that keeps cross-functional delivery moving smoothly and compliantly.

What You'll Do

Delivery & Coordination

  • Liaise with Group Product Managers (GPMs) — Act as a key point of coordination across product fault lines, surfacing decisions that need to be made and driving them to quick, well-informed resolution.

  • Lead daily ceremonies — Run stand-ups and other recurring delivery ceremonies with engineering, keeping teams aligned on priorities, blockers, and progress.

  • Troubleshoot with engineering — Partner directly with engineering leads to unblock delivery issues in real time, digging into technical details as needed.

  • Lead triage for cross-cutting bugs and defects — Own the process for identifying, prioritizing, and assigning ownership of issues that span multiple product areas or teams, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Drive process improvement — Identify recurring delivery bottlenecks or compliance gaps and put in place scalable processes to prevent them.

Platform Delivery (Program)

  • Country-specific requirements — Own the platform-wide program ensuring the platform meets country-specific regulatory and functional requirements (e.g., GDPR and other regional regulations) consistently as we scale globally.

  • Centralize consent management — Lead the program to consolidate consent management (data processing, marketing, cookie consent, etc.) into a single, consistent framework across the platform, replacing fragmented per-product implementations.

  • Build the platform back office for technical support.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including experience in platform or delivery-focused roles.

  • Proven ability to work across multiple teams and stakeholders to drive decisions quickly, especially in ambiguous or contested situations.

  • Strong operational rigor — comfortable running ceremonies, triage processes, and cross-team workflows, alongside running longer-running platform programs and owning a live product.

  • Experience working closely with engineering on troubleshooting and delivery issues; technical fluency is important.

  • Experience owning a partner-facing or multi-market product, with sensitivity to regional variation across a large footprint (70 countries, in this case).

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders (including GPMs) without direct authority.

  • A bias toward action and strong prioritization instincts in a fast-moving, cross-cutting role.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a platform or infrastructure product role at a multi-market or global company.

  • Background working with legal/compliance teams on regulatory rollouts, especially consent management programs.

  • Experience setting up or scaling incident management, bug triage, or internal support tooling.

  • Experience with franchise, partner, or multi-tenant portal products specifically.

Most internal-facing delivery roles are pure coordination — you keep other people's things moving and own nothing yourself.   • Experience managing and scaling an influencer program into 6-digit monthly spend

  • Strategic budget allocation and performance monitoring to grasp and influence crucial KPIs per influencer, optimize resource utilization, and maximize ROI

  • Knowledge of the latest trends and how to apply them to Sunday

What we offer

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

data.description:
About Dataleap
We're the agentic operating system for the enterprise. We enable business teams to build, scale, and manage the most capable AI employees on the market.

We raised $3M from YC and angels like Aravind (CEO Perplexity) and Rahul Vohra (Superhuman). We have thousands of agents running at 2,000+ person scale-ups and Fortune 500 companies. We have PMF and are doubling revenue every month. We have far more demand than we can handle.

About the role
I'm Sacha, Chief of Staff at Dataleap. I own our existing customers, and I need someone alongside me to make our current accounts win with Dataleap.

This isn't a sales role. Your job is to make the customers we already have wildly successful, to walk into their organizations, find the people who want to build agents, and help them actually do it. You'll run adoption on the ground: sit with teams, understand their work, build agents alongside them, unblock them, and turn curious users into daily believers. When a customer succeeds, it's because you made it happen.

We're building out our German office, and this is the moment to get in. You'll work directly with me and our team on the ground. As we scale, this role has a real path to grow into a full-time role in the Growth team at Dataleap, more ownership, bigger accounts, deeper work. This is your chance to show what you've got, and I'll make sure it's the fastest growth of your career.

What you'll own

  • Customer adoption. Drive real usage inside our existing accounts. Find the champions, enable them, and help them pay it forward across their org.

  • Building agents alongside customers. Sit with their teams, understand the messy details of their work, and build agents in Dataleap that solve real problems. You prove the value by shipping it.

  • Being the trusted partner. Become the person our customers love to have in the room, the one who gets their world, makes them better, and makes them feel taken care of.

  • Training and enablement. Run workshops, hackathons, and hands-on sessions that turn non-technical teams into confident agent builders.

  • Being the voice of the customer. Feed what you learn back to me, product, and engineering. Push hard for what our customers need.

  • Automate your own role with Dataleap. We build AI employees for a living, and you'll live in the product you're helping customers adopt. Build agents that eliminate the manual parts of your own job instead of doing them by hand.

Who you are

  • Hungry and proactive. You don't wait to be told. You see what needs doing and you're already on it.

  • Great with people. You're warm, confident, and easy to trust. You can walk into a room of people you've never met and have them rooting for you by the end.

  • Someone customers fall for. The bar is simple: I want customers coming back to me saying "I love this person, what a great hire." You make people feel understood and supported.

  • Super AI-native. You breathe AI. You build agents for everything and you're already living in these tools, not just exploring them.

  • A culture carrier. You embody how we work and represent Dataleap brilliantly out in the world.

  • High agency, low ego. There's unsexy work and you'll do it without flinching. You want to work hard and be part of something ambitious.

  • You speak German at a native level and are fluent in English. Based in Munich or ready to move here.

How we work
This is your life's work right now, and mine too. We operate like athletes: we take care of ourselves and our bodies, and we work hard and win. High standards, high output, no excuses, and we enjoy the ride together.

What this is not

  • Not a coffee-and-shadowing internship, you'll own real customer relationships from week one.

  • Not a back-office role, you're in front of customers, in their offices, in the work.

  • Not for someone who needs rigid structure or waits to be told what to do.

What you get

  • A front-row seat to how AI gets deployed inside real companies, at the absolute frontier.

  • Direct work with me and exposure to our network at YC, Founders Inc, and CDTM.

  • A real path to full-time: grow into a full-time role in the Growth team at Dataleap as we scale.

  • Unlimited AI budget. We practice what we preach.

  • Frequent proof that your work matters, straight from the customers you win over.

How we hire (fast, ~2 weeks start to finish)

  1. Get to know me (Sacha).

  2. Meet the team.

  3. A take-home on a real problem we're facing.

  4. Offer, and you're in.

If this resonates, reach out.

  • Direkter Wachstumshebel: Deine Analysen beeinflussen, welche Themen, Kanäle, Funnels und CRM-Strecken wir priorisieren

  • Daten statt Bauchgefühl: Du baust die Grundlage dafür, dass Marketingentscheidungen messbar, vergleichbar und lernfähig werden

  • KI als echter Produktivitätshebel: Du nutzt AI nicht als Spielerei, sondern für Research, Mustererkennung, Hypothesen, Reporting und bessere Entscheidungen

  • Breite Verantwortung: Du arbeitest nicht nur im Dashboard, sondern denkst CRM, Content, Funnel, Website-Tests und operative Growth-Experimente mit

  • Gestaltungsraum: Du hilfst dabei, Lovebetter von einem content-getriebenen Marketing-Team zu einem klaren Revenue-Marketing-System weiterzuentwickeln

Dein Impact

Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht:

  • ein Marketing-System, das klar erkennt, welche Maßnahmen wirklich Wachstum erzeugen

  • bessere Entscheidungen bei Content, CRM, Paid, SEO, Chatter und Funnel

  • aktivierte Bestandskontakte statt ungenutzter Datenbank

  • mehr qualifizierte Leads durch saubere Hypothesen und Tests

  • ein Weekly Growth Reporting, das dem Team Orientierung und Priorität gibt

  • ein skalierbares Zusammenspiel aus KI, Daten, CRM und Customer Journey

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung.
Erzähl uns lieber:

  • welche Marketing-, BI- oder Growth-Systeme du bereits aufgebaut oder verbessert hast

  • wie du KI heute konkret in deiner Arbeit nutzt

  • welche Hypothesen oder Tests du schon entwickelt und ausgewertet hast

  • wo du schon Verantwortung für Reporting, CRM, Funnel oder Performance getragen hast

  • und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetter datenbasiert und wachstumsseitig auf das nächste Level bringst


Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht)

Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …

  • du mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Marketing Analytics, BI, Growth, Performance Marketing oder Revenue Operations hast

  • du exzellent mit Zahlen, Daten und Zusammenhängen arbeitest und daraus klare Wachstumshebel ableitest

  • du KI täglich nutzt, um Analysen, Research, Hypothesen, Segmentierungen oder Prozesse schneller und besser zu machen

  • du CRM, Funnel und Lifecycle-Marketing verstehst und erkennst, wie aus Kontakten qualifizierte Leads und Umsatz entstehen

  • du Hypothesen klar formulieren, testen und auswerten kannst

  • du strukturiert, eigenständig und lösungsorientiert arbeitest und dem CMO klar sagen kannst: „Das ist der Hebel. Das sollten wir testen. Das sollten wir stoppen.“

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn …

  • du Zahlen nur „berichtest“, aber daraus keine klaren Entscheidungen ableitest

  • du KI spannend findest, sie aber nicht aktiv in deinen Arbeitsalltag integrierst

  • du dich ausschließlich als Dashboard- oder Reporting-Person verstehst

  • du kein Interesse daran hast, CRM, Content, Paid, Website und Funnel zusammenzudenken

  • du dich in Analysen verlierst, ohne ins Handeln zu kommen

Wir suchen motivierte und inspirierende Personen, die unser Team als Kampfsporttrainer (M/W/D) unterstützen. In dieser Position haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre Leidenschaft für Kampfsportarten zu teilen und unsere Schüler zu inspirieren und zu motivieren.

  • Leiten von Kampfsportkursen für verschiedene Altersgruppen und Erfahrungsstufen

  • Entwicklung von Trainingsplänen und -programmen

  • Individuelle Betreuung und Unterstützung der Schüler

  • Förderung eines positiven und motivierenden Lernumfelds

  • Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Trainern und dem Management, um den Erfolg der Abteilung sicherzustellen

Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für Kampfsportarten haben und gerne mit Menschen arbeiten, dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Werden Sie Teil unseres engagierten Teams und helfen Sie uns, die Begeisterung für Kampfsport zu verbreiten!


  • Du willst mit Kindern im Alter von 3 bis 12 Jahren kreativ arbeiten: Du hast eine Leidenschaft dafür, Kinder zu unterrichten und zu inspirieren. Du nutzt kreative Ansätze, um jedem Kind die Freude an Bewegung und die Grundwerte des Kampfsports nahezubringen.

  • Du hast Spaß auf der Matte und beim Training geben: Die Matte ist Dein Zuhause, und Du liebst es, Deine Begeisterung für Kampfsport und Fitness zu teilen. Du gestaltest jede Trainingseinheit motivierend und abwechslungsreich, um Mitglieder aller Altersklassen zu fördern.

  • Du besitzt gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich: Deine Fähigkeit, klar und verständlich zu kommunizieren, hilft Dir, sowohl mit Kindern als auch mit Erwachsenen effektiv zu interagieren. Du bist in der Lage, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen, und kannst komplexe Inhalte einfach und zugänglich vermitteln.

  • Zuverlässigkeit und Teamgeist sind für Dich unerlässlich: Du bist eine verlässliche Stütze für das Team und verstehst, dass gemeinsamer Erfolg auf Vertrauen und Zusammenarbeit basiert. Du hältst Deine Zusagen ein, bist pünktlich und unterstützt Deine Kollegen und die Mitglieder unserer Sportschule, wo immer es nötig ist.

  • Du bist motiviert, Dich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln: Dein Streben nach Verbesserung endet nicht bei Dir selbst; Du suchst ständig nach Wegen, Deine Fähigkeiten zu erweitern und neue Lehrmethoden zu erlernen, um das Trainingserlebnis für alle Beteiligten zu verbessern.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Video Creator & Editor based in Germany.

This role combines AI video generation and hands-on editing to create high-performing direct-response advertising for Meta and TikTok.
You will own creatives end to end, from interpreting briefs and generating AI footage to editing polished, launch-ready ads.
The position focuses on UGC-style talking-head content, product scenes, b-roll, hooks, variations, and conversion-driven storytelling.
You will work closely with Creative Strategists and the Paid Social team to turn concepts and performance insights into compelling new assets.
Success means consistently delivering high-quality, on-brief creatives at volume while keeping revisions low and continuously improving what performs.
You will join a growing remote video team and have access to AI tools, established workflows, and real campaign environments in which to develop your skills.
The role is fully remote, full-time, and follows UK working hours.


Accountabilities
  • Generate AI video assets for Meta and TikTok advertising, including UGC-style talking-head clips, product scenes, b-roll, and complete concept videos.
  • Develop and refine prompts, reference images, and generation settings while maintaining a reusable library of effective prompts and workflows.
  • Edit high-volume direct-response ads by combining AI-generated footage with scripts, raw footage, UGC, and approved product assets.
  • Create compelling first-second hooks, rapid pacing, subtitles, pattern interrupts, product demonstrations, offers, and clear calls to action.
  • Produce multiple variations of successful concepts by testing different hooks, scenes, characters, openings, pacing, and visual treatments.
  • Maintain visual consistency across characters, products, and brand assets while quality-checking generated content for realistic motion, readable text, accurate product representation, and other AI-generation issues.
  • Add motion graphics using After Effects or an equivalent tool and ensure creatives meet platform and brand requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with Creative Strategists to execute briefs accurately, respond quickly to feedback, and contribute new angles, hooks, and formats suited to AI generation.
  • Keep project files, assets, and feedback organized using Google Drive, Frame.io, or similar collaboration and asset-management tools.
  • Stay current with evolving AI video models and creative technologies, testing new tools and incorporating effective workflows into production.
  • Maintain reliable turnaround times and a high-quality output while contributing to creative testing, learning, and scalable advertising concepts.

    • Requirements:

    • Bring 1–3 years of experience in creative or video production, including e-commerce or direct-response paid-social editing, with a portfolio demonstrating both self-edited conversion-focused ads and AI-generated video work.
    • Have hands-on experience with AI video-generation tools such as Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Sora, Runway, or similar platforms, with strong prompting and iteration skills.
    • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Premiere Pro or CapCut, together with After Effects or equivalent motion-graphics capabilities.
    • Be comfortable using Google Drive, Frame.io, or similar tools for organized asset management, collaboration, and feedback.
    • Understand hook-first, direct-response editing for Meta and TikTok, including rapid pacing, subtitles, pattern interrupts, visual proof, product demonstrations, offers, CTAs, and testable creative variations.
    • Have a strong visual eye and the ability to distinguish AI-generated footage that feels authentic from content that appears artificial or unrealistic.
    • Be able to maintain high output without sacrificing quality, respond quickly to feedback, and work accurately under pressure.
    • Demonstrate creativity, problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and a thoughtful, methodical approach to production.
    • Have strong written and spoken English, proactive communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a remote creative team.
    • Be available for a full-time, exclusive commitment without other clients or freelance work alongside the role.
    • Experience with AI image-generation tools such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, or Flux, AI voice tools such as ElevenLabs, winning or scaled advertising campaigns, visually driven DTC categories, motion design, compositing, 3D, VFX, or sound design is considered a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation discussed individually based on experience and location.
      • Fully remote, full-time work following UK working hours.
      • Access to AI video-generation tools and approved creative workflows.
      • Opportunities to develop AI generation and video-editing skills through real advertising campaigns.
      • Regular structured meetings and scheduled feedback sessions with the creative team.
      • The opportunity to join a new ten-person video team operating in a high-volume creative testing environment.
      • Room for professional growth as AI models, creative workflows, and production capabilities continue to evolve.

data.description:
Work alongside our innovative team based in Auckland, New Zealand! We are seeking talented individuals excited about the opportunity to learn, expand their skillset and support our company.
 
We welcome applications from individuals located internationally looking to relocate to Auckland, New Zealand. This role is based in Auckland and requires in-office attendance (hybrid). 
 
Propellerhead hires exceptional talent from all around the globe and many of our people have relocated to New Zealand to join our team. We've created this website packed full of information about moving to New Zealand to work for Propellerhead, if you're interested in making the move to our wonderful country.
 
Prior to applying, please be aware that the final stage of our recruitment process is an in-person interview in New Zealand (click apply and see our application questions for more details).
 
 

The Role: 

At Propellerhead, the Technical Strategist role focuses on the delivery of resilient software systems that power everything from complex infrastructure to innovative new platforms. This role works alongside our Product Strategists to shape the technical specification and platform direction for a portfolio of client products.

We’re looking for someone who combines architectural insight with a strong hands-on engineering background and a genuinely AI-native way of working. You will have spent the formative part of your career as a software developer and still be confident with understanding the structure of software solutions. You'll have knowledge of emerging trends and you are agentic-first where you reach for AI to rapidly prototype new ideas and judge their value in hours, not weeks, and you are at home with directing an AI-assisted delivery pipeline.

You will lead and guide the design of complex systems, and we'll depend on your extensive experience, judgement and insights to ensure that early delivery and continuous improvement is possible. You’ll be applying and reinforcing Engineering standards for programming, and shape the technical solutions our AI-assisted pipeline builds, in a lean and evolutionary manner. Importantly, you will be responsible for ensuring that client platforms align with our technical strategy. You will work closely with the Chief Technologist and Engineering Principal to apply standards, patterns, and tooling in client contexts, and provide informed input into technical strategy through client platform insights and delivery experience.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity.

If you're looking to contribute your insight and engineering experience to projects that matter - we would like to hear from you.


Skills & Experience Required:
  • 8+ years of experience with the development of multi-tier and distributed applications. 
  • Agentic-first: very comfortable using AI to rapidly prototype, shape solutions, and direct an AI-assisted delivery pipeline across requirements, testing and code generation. This is central to the role.
  • A confident, credible communicator and presenter in front of senior client stakeholders.
  • Our current technologies include React user interfaces, with services written in C#, so previous experience with both is essential. However we also have Typescript, Java, Go and Rust services, so you will need to show confidence in working with a variety of programming languages.
  • Strong communication skills must be demonstrable, with tangible examples of your skills to bridge technical solutions with business needs and present these concepts to a variety of internal and customer stakeholders. 
  • Hands-on experience with designing solutions on Azure is essential, including active participation in building CI/CD pipelines and instrumenting for operations, is required.
  • Experience with streaming and messaging platforms, such as Kafka or NATS, is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in leading the design of complex software applications, preferably for corporate enterprise, where solutions comprise existing services alongside custom development.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You will represent Propellerhead in front of stakeholders, so a professional, confident presence and the ability to communicate and influence with clarity are essential.
  • We are particularly looking for technical leaders with experience or demonstrable interest in any of the following: digital identity, verifiable credentials, open banking, AI agent authorization, edge or device-based software deployment.

    • Responsibilities:
  • Authoring, reviewing and communicating solution architecture and specifications in collaboration with the Development teams and our core Engineering team.
  • Championing the technical strategy of Propellerhead as our key business differentiator, and aligning design and implementation of the solutions in your portfolio in line with that technical vision.

What you do

We optimise and market a growing portfolio of flexible assets on European power markets - battery storage, aggregated EV fleets and renewable generation. Our multi-market optimisation and execution is purely algorithm-driven and fully automated. What decides whether we make money is the quality of our market view: price patterns, forecasts, fundamental models and the assessment of risk.

  • You own price and generation forecasting across and keep the short-term and long-term views consistent
  • You develop and implement analytical models and forecasting tools to assess electricity and renewable energy markets as well as delivery data-driven insights and signals for our trading decisions  
  • You assess market trends, regulatory developments and new markets quantitatively, providing the basis for country and product decisions
  • You lead a team of 5-7 analysts & data scientist, develop them technically and coach them in their personal growth
  • You work closely with Trading Desk, Portfolio Management, Pricing, Sales and Product, building the bridge to develop cutting edge products and services
  • You create reports, monitorings and benchmarks to derive actionable insights for trading, senior management and other stakeholders
  •  your models feed into bids and prices largely automatically, and into the decisions of the management board
  • You own risk: the limit system, the monitoring of positions and exposures, scenario and stress-test methodology, and risk reporting to the Head of Trading and the management board


Who you are

  • Several years of experience in quantitative analysis on European power markets - forecasting, fundamental modelling or risk
  • A solid understanding of day-ahead, intraday and ancillary services, capacity and local flexibility markets, and of how prices form in them

  • Proaktive Entwicklung neuer Themen und Beratungsangebote (z. B. Plattform-Weiterentwicklung, UX, Technologie, Redaktionsprozesse, KI)

  • Die operative Projektleitung liegt bei unseren Projektmanager*innen – du behältst die Perspektive auf das Gesamtmandat.


Was du mitbringst.

  • Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Auftraggeber*innen und Verständnis für Verwaltung und öffentliche Kommunikation

  • Du musst heute noch keinen vergleichbaren Großaccount vollständig verantwortet haben – die Position eignet sich auch als nächster Schritt für erfahrene Senior Consultants, Account Manager*innen oder Senior Project Manager*innen mit dem Wunsch nach mehr strategischer und wirtschaftlicher Verantwortung.

Was die Rolle besonders macht
  • Ein großes, langfristig angelegtes Mandat mit erheblichem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Ein festes Kernteam, das du um weitere Spezialist*innen ergänzen kannst.
  • Die Möglichkeit, komplexe digitale Plattformen über mehrere Jahre hinweg mitzuprägen – statt möglichst viele Projekte selbst zu managen.
  • Für die Rolle ist regelmäßige persönliche Präsenz beim Kunden wichtig – daher suchen wir insbesondere jemanden mit Wohnsitz oder dauerhaftem beruflichem Schwerpunkt in der Region Rheinland-Pfalz/Mainz.


Wen wir suchen.

Eine*n Client Service Director für den Public Sector. Ab sofort. Mit beruflichem Schwerpunkt in der Region Rheinland-Pfalz/Mainz


Was wir bieten.

Keine Schokoriegel, sondern digitale Erlebnisse. Keine Turnschuhe, sondern Fitness für die graue Zellen. Weil: komplexe Themen – anspruchsvolle Kund*innen.  
Was noch? Kluge und sympathische Kolleg*innen. Relevante Auftraggebende. Inhaltlich Herausforderndes. Reichlich Abwechslung. Flache Hierarchien. Und die Chance, gemeinsam mit uns kräftig aufs Gas zu drücken. Wir stehen für familienfreundliches Arbeiten. Hybrid Work. Raum für individuelle Weiterentwicklung und fachbezogene Veranstaltungen. Und obendrauf mit RYSM INTEGRAL Teil der Hirschen Group und auf internationaler Ebene Partner von WPP zu sein.


Was, wenn's passt?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung von qualifizierten Menschen. Jeder geschlechtlichen und sexuellen Identität. Jeden Alters. Von Bewerbenden mit Migrationshintergrund, People of Colour  und / oder Menschen mit Behinderungen. Wiedereinsteiger*innen. Eltern. Quereinsteiger*innen. Alle sind bei uns gleichermaßen willkommen.

Schick uns gerne deine Bewerbungsunterlagen und lass uns wissen, wann du frühestens einsteigen kannst und wie deine Gehaltsvorstellungen sind. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du deine Unterlagen auch anonymisiert als Blind-Bewerbung einreichen – wir stellen einen fairen und transparenten Auswahlprozess sicher. Wir freuen uns auf dich.

Und noch ein Hinweis: Wir nehmen Informationssicherheit ernst – und freuen uns, wenn du diesen Anspruch mit uns teilst.

data.description:
Ihre nächste SAP-Basis-Rolle sollte mehr sein als der stabile Betrieb von Systemen.

Wenn Sie seit mehreren Jahren im SAP-Basis-Umfeld arbeiten, kennen Sie die klassischen Aufgaben:

Systeme überwachen.
Transporte steuern.
Störungen beheben.
Upgrades durchführen.
Den Betrieb stabil halten.

Alles wichtige Aufgaben.

Doch was wäre, wenn Ihre nächste Position Ihnen die Möglichkeit gibt, eine globale SAP-Landschaft aktiv weiterzuentwickeln und ihre technologische Zukunft mitzugestalten?

Für ein international aufgestelltes Unternehmen mit langfristiger, familiengeprägter Unternehmenskultur suchen wir einen erfahrenen Manager SAP Basis Solutions (m/w/d) am Standort Mannheim.

Die SAP-Landschaft umfasst SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA sowie moderne SAP-Plattformen und befindet sich in einer kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung hin zu einer stärker integrierten, sicheren und zukunftsfähigen Systemlandschaft.

**Die Position richtet sich an jemanden, der über die klassische Administration hinaus Verantwortung übernehmen möchte, für Stabilität, Sicherheit, Performance, Automatisierung und technologische Weiterentwicklung.
**

Aufgaben

Was macht diese Position besonders?

Sie verantworten nicht einfach ein einzelnes SAP-System.

Sie arbeiten in einer globalen und sich weiterentwickelnden SAP-Plattformlandschaft und verbinden operativen Betrieb mit Technologie, Transformation und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

Ihre Aufgaben umfassen:

  • Sicherstellung des stabilen, sicheren und performanten Betriebs der globalen SAP-Systemlandschaft inklusive SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA und weiterer SAP-Plattformen
  • Operative SAP-Basisadministration mit Schwerpunkt auf Systemmonitoring, Transport-, Job-, Druck- und Schnittstellenmanagement sowie Performanceanalyse und Troubleshooting
  • Planung und technische Umsetzung von Upgrades, Releasewechseln, Migrationen, Systemkopien, Templates und internationalen Rollout-Projekten
  • Administration und Weiterentwicklung moderner SAP-Plattformen wie SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Cloud ALM und SAP RISE Private Cloud Edition
  • Koordination und fachliche Steuerung externer Dienstleister, Hosting-Provider und SAP-Berater sowie Sicherstellung der vereinbarten Servicequalität
  • Technische Begleitung von SAP-Systemvermessungen sowie Analyse der SAP-Lizenznutzung zur Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung der SAP-Betriebsprozesse mit Fokus auf Verfügbarkeit, Security, Compliance, Performance und Zukunftsfähigkeit

Kurz gesagt:

Sie sorgen nicht nur dafür, dass die SAP-Landschaft heute funktioniert.
Sie helfen dabei, sie für morgen besser, sicherer und automatisierter zu machen.

Qualifikation

Was sollten Sie mitbringen?

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit mit fundierter SAP-Basis-Expertise und Interesse an modernen SAP-Technologien.

Sie bringen idealerweise mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Praktische Erfahrung in der SAP-Basisadministration sowie im Betrieb komplexer SAP-ECC- und SAP-S/4HANA-Systemlandschaften
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP NetWeaver und SAP HANA, insbesondere in Monitoring, Transportmanagement, Systemkopien, Upgrades, Migrationen und Troubleshooting
  • Erfahrung mit hybriden SAP-Landschaften sowie modernen SAP-Technologien wie SAP BTP und SAP Cloud ALM; Kenntnisse in SAP RISE Private Cloud Edition sind von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse in SAP Security, Rollen und Berechtigungen, Zertifikatsmanagement, Hochverfügbarkeit sowie Backup- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepten
  • Erfahrung mit technischer SAP-Systemvermessung und der Bewertung der Lizenznutzung
  • Erfahrung in der Koordination und fachlichen Steuerung externer Service Provider
  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Sie müssen nicht jede einzelne Technologie perfekt beherrschen.

**Wenn Sie eine solide SAP-Basis-Expertise mitbringen und Lust darauf haben, sich in eine moderne, international ausgerichtete SAP-Plattformlandschaft weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns ebenfalls auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme.
**

Benefits

Was erwartet Sie?

Sie arbeiten in einem global agierenden Unternehmen, das internationale Größe mit der langfristigen Orientierung eines familiengeprägten Geschäftsmodells verbindet.

Freuen Sie sich auf:

  • Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket inklusive Unternehmenserfolgsbeteiligung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Eine globale SAP-Landschaft mit Einblicken in S/4HANA, HANA, BTP, Cloud ALM und RISE
  • Die Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung des SAP-Betriebs aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Individuelle Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und umfangreiche Online-Lernangebote über einen eigenen LearningHub

Du hast Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen, behältst auch bei mehreren offenen Themen den Überblick und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären?

Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu dir passen.

Bei eHealth-Connect entwickeln wir digitale Lösungen für die vernetzte Gesundheitsversorgung. Unsere Produkte werden von unterschiedlichen Akteuren im Gesundheitswesen genutzt – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen, wenn Fragen entstehen, Prozesse nicht wie erwartet laufen oder technische Unterstützung benötigt wird.

Dabei geht es bei uns nicht um klassischen Callcenter-Support, sondern darum, Probleme wirklich zu verstehen, strukturiert einzugrenzen und gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Teams Lösungen zu finden.

Warum brauchen wir diese Rolle?

Mit unseren Produkten, Kunden und Anwendungsfällen wächst auch die Zahl der Themen, die im täglichen Betrieb schnell und zuverlässig gelöst werden müssen. Deshalb möchten wir unseren Support weiter professionalisieren und suchen jemanden, der Supportfälle strukturiert übernimmt, technische Zusammenhänge analysiert und dafür sorgt, dass unsere Kund:innen schnell die richtige Unterstützung bekommen. Gleichzeitig bist du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zu unseren technischen und fachlichen Teams: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder, bereitest komplexere Fälle sauber auf und hilfst damit auch uns, unsere Produkte und Prozesse kontinuierlich besser zu machen.

Warum ist die Rolle spannend?

Du bearbeitest bei uns nicht einfach Tickets nach Schema F.

Unsere Lösungen bewegen sich in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld und verbinden Software, unterschiedliche Systeme, Schnittstellen und Prozesse im Gesundheitswesen miteinander. Das bedeutet: Hinter einer Supportanfrage steckt manchmal eine einfache Bedienfrage – manchmal aber auch ein technisches Puzzle. Du lernst unsere Produkte und Systeme sehr genau kennen, arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Deployment und Fachbereichen zusammen und entwickelst mit der Zeit ein gutes Gespür dafür, wo ein Problem entsteht und wie wir es am besten lösen können.

Aufgaben

Was sind deine Aufgaben?

  • Annahme, Erfassung und Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen unserer Kund:innen
  • Unterstützung der Anwender:innen bei Fragen zur Bedienung und zu den Prozessen unserer Produkte
  • Analyse und erste Eingrenzung technischer und fachlicher Fehler
  • Prüfung von Fehlermeldungen, Prozessstatus, Logs und vorhandenen Systeminformationen
  • Klassifizierung und Priorisierung von Supportfällen sowie Überwachung vereinbarter Service Levels
  • Lösung bekannter Störungen anhand vorhandener Dokumentationen und Workarounds
  • Qualifizierte Eskalation komplexerer Fälle an 2nd Level, Entwicklung oder zuständige Fachbereiche
  • Nachvollziehbare Dokumentation von Lösungen und wiederkehrenden Fehlerbildern in unserer Wissensdatenbank

Qualifikation

Was hilft dir, in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein?

Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtig ist uns vor allem, dass du gerne Probleme löst, strukturiert arbeitest und Freude an der Kommunikation mit Menschen hast.

  • Erfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder technischen Kundensupport ist von Vorteil
  • Gutes technisches Verständnis sowie eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen sowie im Umgang mit Fehlermeldungen und Logs
  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie eine klare, freundliche und verbindliche Kommunikation
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Kenntnisse im IT-Service-Management, zum Beispiel nach ITIL v4, sind wünschenswert
  • Grundkenntnisse in Webanwendungen, APIs und JSON sind von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

Uns ist wichtiger, wie du an Probleme herangehst, wie du kommunizierst und ob du Lust hast, dich in unsere Produkte und Technologien einzuarbeiten, als dass du bereits jedes Kästchen erfüllst. Auch der sinnvolle Einsatz von KI im Arbeitsalltag wird bei uns ausdrücklich gefördert und ist bereits Teil unserer Arbeitsweise.

Über eHealth-Connect

Wir entwickeln Software und digitale Lösungen für eine moderne, vernetzte Gesundheitsversorgung. Unsere Technologien verbinden unterschiedliche Akteure und Systeme im Gesundheitswesen und tragen dazu bei, digitale Versorgung einfacher, sicherer und besser nutzbar zu machen.

Dabei arbeiten wir an der Schnittstelle zwischen moderner Softwareentwicklung, Telematikinfrastruktur und neuen digitalen Versorgungskonzepten.

Wir arbeiten hybrid und haben ein modernes Büro in Berlin-Mitte, das wir als Ort für Zusammenarbeit, Austausch und gemeinsame Teamtage nutzen.

Klingt nach etwas, das zu dir passen könnte?

Dann melde dich bei uns. Ob mit Lebenslauf oder einfach ein paar Sätzen darüber, wer du bist, was du bisher gemacht hast und warum dich die Rolle interessiert – wir möchten vor allem dich kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns auf dich.

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.

We want you to grow with us 

We are expanding our international IT organisation and looking for an ERP Rollout Project Manager – Manufacturing & Supply Chain to join our cross-functional IT Project and Portfolio Management Team. In this role, you will manage IT delivery within ERP implementation and rollout projects across multiple functions, sites and countries. As part of the wider rollout team, you will ensure that technical, infrastructure and operational activities are planned and aligned with the overall ERP rollout. You will combine strong IT project management capabilities with a solid understanding of ERP environments and the technology dependencies required to successfully deploy them within manufacturing operations. Your work will help modernise our systems, harmonise processes and deploy new capabilities across our European operations.

Please note: This role may require travel to Intersnack locations and project offices up to 30–40% of the time.

What we can offer 

You will have the opportunity to manage IT delivery across the lifecycle of international ERP rollout projects, from planning and mobilisation through testing, deployment, cutover, go-live and stabilisation.

Working closely with business teams, IT specialists, local sites and external partners, you will operate at the intersection of ERP, business processes and site technology. This includes ensuring that infrastructure, devices, access and other technical dependencies are ready to support manufacturing, supply chain and logistics operations.

How you will spend your time as our next ERP Rollout Project Manager 

As our next ERP Rollout Project Manager – Manufacturing & Supply Chain (internal title: IT Project Manager), you will manage ERP-related projects within the IT area as part of the overall rollout team. You will own the IT project plan, coordinate the relevant workstreams and ensure that milestones, dependencies, risks and deliverables remain aligned with the wider rollout.

  • Manage IT delivery within ERP implementation and rollout projects from planning through go-live, stabilisation and transition to support 

  • Own and maintain the IT project plan, ensuring alignment with the wider ERP rollout and its business and functional workstreams 

  • Coordinate internal IT teams, business stakeholders, local sites, external implementation partners and service providers 

  • Translate rollout requirements into clear project activities, milestones, dependencies and deliverables 

  • Ensure infrastructure and site technology requirements are incorporated into the rollout plan, including connectivity, user access, handheld devices, scanners and printers 

  • Coordinate testing, deployment, site readiness, cutover and go-live activities within the assigned IT scope 

  • Manage project scope, timelines, resources, budgets, risks, issues and dependencies, including appropriate reporting and escalation

  • Support business readiness, training coordination and post-go-live stabilisation together with the wider rollout team

  • Apply established project management standards and contribute to continuous improvement of project delivery across the portfolio


What we expect from you 

  • Several years of experience managing complex IT projects, including experience within an end-to-end ERP implementation or rollout

Deine Benefits

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.  

  • Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.

  • Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.  

  • Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Data Engineer entwickelst und betreibst du moderne Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Daten zuverlässig für Analysen, Reporting und Machine-Learning-Anwendungen bereitstehen. 

  • Data Engineering: Konzeption, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datenpipelines in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Datenqualität: Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität, Vollständigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit sowie Implementierung effizienter inkrementeller Datenladeprozesse.  

  • Datenintegration: Entwicklung und Pflege effizienter ETL-/ELT-Prozesse sowie API-basierter Datenintegrationen.  

  • Plattformbetrieb: Entwicklung robuster Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungskonzepte sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance, Kosten und Datenworkflows.  

  • Data Architecture: Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer skalierbaren Datenarchitektur inklusive Test-, Staging- und Produktionsumgebungen sowie moderner Technologien wie CI/CD, Fabric Pipelines, dbt oder Airflow.  

  • Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Data & Analytics und den Data Analysts zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Daten für Power BI Dashboards und Machine-Learning-Modelle. 

Dein Profil als Data Engineer

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenpipelines oder Datenplattformen – idealerweise auf Senior-Level, motivierte Mid-Level-Profile sind ebenfalls willkommen.  

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure Data Services, insbesondere Data Factory und/oder Azure Synapse; idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python, insbesondere im Bereich ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Automatisierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung, idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen.  

  • Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.  

  • Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.  

  • Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Bei geringeren Deutschkenntnissen (ab B1) werden dafür sehr gute Englischkenntnisse vorausgesetzt.  

Nice-to-haves – jedes zusätzliche Know-how ist ein Pluspunkt:

  • Erfahrung mit inkrementellen Ladeprozessen und Delta-Verarbeitung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenintegration für Power BI sowie im Umgang mit semantischen Modellen.  

  • Kenntnisse im E-Commerce- oder Amazon-Umfeld.  

  • Erfahrung mit API-basierten Datenintegrationen.  

  • Kenntnisse in CI/CD, z. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps.  

  • Interesse an Machine Learning und dem Aufbau datengetriebener Organisationen.  

  • Erfahrung mit Openbridge. 

Die Rolle als Data Engineer klingt genau nach dir? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir geben dir in einem kurzen Telefonat alle weiteren Infos zu Stelle und Unternehmen.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, we are seeking an Engagement Manager to lead the implementation of AI-driven initiatives powered by QVAC, Tether’s SDK for local AI and delegated inference. The role focuses on orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder deployments of decentralized AI solutions across enterprise, government, and institutional environments.

This position combines client engagement, technical coordination, and delivery oversight to ensure successful onboarding and execution of AI use cases, ranging from edge AI deployments to privacy-preserving inference systems. The Engagement Manager plays a central role in aligning client objectives with product capabilities, coordinating internal and external stakeholders, and driving implementations from initial scoping through production rollout.

Responsibilities

Client & Partner Engagement

  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients and partners during AI implementation initiatives, ensuring clear communication, expectation alignment, and structured execution.

  • Guide clients in translating business requirements into AI deployment strategies leveraging QVAC capabilities (local inference, delegated compute, privacy-preserving architectures).

  • Support Expansion team in shaping AI-related opportunities by providing input on feasibility, integration complexity, and delivery approach.

  • Identify opportunities to extend implementations across additional use cases, geographies, or Tether technologies.

Implementations Oversight

  • Lead end-to-end coordination of QVAC-based implementations from kickoff through production deployment.

  • Define implementation roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies across AI models, infrastructure, and integration layers.

  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and actual product capabilities, avoiding scope drift or mispositioning.

  • Track progress across multiple concurrent AI deployments, ensuring timely delivery and readiness for production environments.

Cross-functional Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with product, engineering, and research teams to align on QVAC capabilities, limitations, and roadmap evolution.

  • Facilitate integration between client systems and QVAC components, including model deployment pipelines, APIs, and compute environments.

  • Work with legal and compliance teams where required, particularly in sensitive AI deployments involving data locality or privacy constraints.

  • Maintain structured communication flows across all stakeholders involved in the implementation lifecycle.

Governance & Reporting

  • Establish and maintain governance frameworks including implementation plans, risk tracking, and decision logs.

  • Produce executive-level updates summarizing progress, risks, blockers, and next steps.

  • Ensure documentation of implementation architectures, deployment patterns, and key learnings for reuse across future projects.

  • Support escalation management and ensure timely resolution of technical or operational challenges.


Core Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, technical account management, or delivery roles within AI, data infrastructure, or complex technology environments.

  • Proven experience managing cross-functional implementations involving multiple stakeholders (internal teams, clients, external partners).

  • Strong ability to operate at the intersection of technical and business domains.

Technical Understanding

  • Familiarity with AI/ML deployment concepts, including model inference, edge/local AI, and distributed compute architectures.

  • Understanding of APIs, SDK integrations, and system architecture patterns.

  • Ability to engage in technical discussions with engineering teams while maintaining business-level clarity with clients.

Communication & Execution

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with enterprise or government entities.

  • Structured approach to project tracking, documentation, and governance.

  • Ability to manage ambiguity and operate in fast-evolving, early-stage environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with decentralized technologies, blockchain, or privacy-preserving systems.

  • Exposure to AI infrastructure tooling or MLOps workflows.

  • Experience in regulated industries or public sector projects.

  • Basic familiarity with programming or scripting environments (Python, APIs, CLI tools).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

As a Senior Mobile Security Developer, you will define squad-level technical architecture and technical approach. You are a technical expert who ensures quality, security, and compliance across projects, driving robust and scalable solutions.

This role will be pivotal in building, delivering, and driving the security of our mobile platform, while being an integral part of our full-stack mobile practice, contributing to end-to-end development and security excellence across both front-end and back-end mobile systems.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Design and Delivery of a World-Class Security Framework: Lead the design and delivery of security services, including mobile penetration testing, research, consultancy, and advisory engagements.

  • Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define secure technical approaches, identify risks, and develop effective threat models and mitigation strategies.

  • Strategic Planning: Translate business objectives into technical strategy and ensure technical roadmaps align with long-term client goals.

  • Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, manage expectations, and provide practical, risk-based security recommendations.

We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring:

  • Mobile Security Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of Android and iOS security fundamentals, common mobile threats and vulnerabilities, security architecture, controls, and mitigation techniques.

  • Mobile Security Testing: Practical experience in mobile penetration testing, security assessments, threat modelling, and implementing or assessing security controls.

  • Security Problem Solving: A systematic and analytical approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving mobile security issues.

  • Authentication & Cryptography: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, cryptography, encryption, and secure design principles, with the ability to recommend appropriate cryptographic controls.

  • Continuous Improvement: A proactive approach to improving security practices, tooling, controls, and ways of working.

Desirable knowledge & experience:

  • Development & Reverse Engineering: Familiarity with C, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, JavaScript, Python or Bash, and ideally ARM/ARM64 assembly.

  • Security Research: Awareness of emerging security technologies, Cloud security, and developments in mobile operating systems, APIs, tools, and security libraries.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one
